spots.name: 北戴河海滨风景区
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区中海滩
spots.desc: 北戴河海滨风景区位于河北省秦皇岛市西部，是中国开发最早、知名度最高的海滨避暑胜地，与南戴河、山海关同属秦皇岛旅游核心区。1898年清政府将此地辟为“各国人士避暑地”，此后逐渐建成大批别墅、疗养院，至今保留着北戴河近代建筑群等历史遗存。景区海岸线绵延约20公里，沙质细软、水温适宜、坡度平缓，是华北地区少见的天然优质海水浴场。核心看点包括鸽子窝公园看日出、老虎石海上公园戏水看日落、联峰山登高望海、怪楼奇园亲子探秘。适合家庭度假、避暑纳凉、摄影与近代建筑爱好者，夏季6-9月是传统旅游旺季。
spots.bestSeason: 6-9月海水浴旺季气候最宜人
spots.suitableFor: 全家出游、情侣、摄影爱好者、近代建筑与历史爱好者
spots.tips: 建议至少安排一整天，行程可串联鸽子窝、老虎石、联峰山、怪楼奇园等多个收费景点 上午看日出、傍晚看日落，中午避开暴晒时段 旺季（暑期）人流量大，酒店和网红打卡点建议提前预订 近代别墅建筑群多为疗养院或办公场所，部分不对外开放，注意遵守指示牌
spots.transport: 公共交通:秦皇岛站乘34路公交车约40分钟可达北戴河海滨；北戴河高铁站距海滨约12公里，站前有公交及出租车；北京南站/北京站有直达高铁约2.5小时到北戴河站 自驾:北京经京哈高速约3小时；天津经沿海高速约3小时；沈阳经京哈高速约3小时；秦皇岛站/北戴河站打车约10-30分钟

spots.descEn: Beidaihe is a coastal resort on the northern shore of Bohai Bay in Qinhuangdao, Hebei, first opened as a summer retreat by the Qing government in 1898 and later favored by national leaders for its cooler climate. Its roughly 20-kilometer beach has fine sand and calm, shallow water, making it one of northern China's best natural sea-bathing areas. Highlights include sunrise at Pigeon Nest Park, sunset at Tiger Stone Park, hilltop sea views from Lianfeng Mountain, and the historic villa district. It suits families, swimmers, and history or architecture enthusiasts, especially June through September.

faq.q: 北戴河海滨风景区本身要门票吗？
faq.a: 海滨风景区不设门票，免费进入，但区内老虎石、鸽子窝、联峰山等具体景点大多单独收费。

faq.q: 北戴河和南戴河是一个地方吗？
faq.a: 不是，北戴河属秦皇岛市区，是传统避暑区；南戴河在昌黎县，以娱乐游乐项目为主。
6-9月适合下海游泳，5月和10月气候凉爽、人少景美，适合观光和摄影。

spots.bestSeasonEn: June to September is the most pleasant for sea bathing
spots.suitableForEn: Families, couples, photographers, and fans of early modern architecture and history
spots.ticketNotesEn: Entry to the coastal scenic area itself is free; individual attractions inside (Pigeon Nest Park, Lianfeng Mountain Park, the Strange House Garden, Biluota Tower, etc.) charge separate admission. During peak season it's best to book tickets for these sub-attractions in advance via Ctrip or Meituan to avoid queues.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Open around the clock (the coastal area itself has no gates; individual attractions inside — Tiger Stone, Pigeon Nest Park, Lianfeng Mountain, the Strange House Garden — charge admission separately and keep their own hours).

transportEn.publicTransit: Bus 34 from Qinhuangdao Railway Station takes about 40 minutes to reach the Beidaihe coast; Beidaihe High-Speed Railway Station is about 12 km from the beach, with buses and taxis outside the station; direct high-speed trains from Beijing South and Beijing stations reach Beidaihe Station in about 2.5 hours.
transportEn.driving: About 3 hours from Beijing via the Beijing–Harbin Expressway; about 3 hours from Tianjin via the coastal expressway; about 3 hours from Shenyang via the Beijing–Harbin Expressway; a taxi from Qinhuangdao or Beidaihe station takes 10-30 minutes.

tipsEn: Plan for at least a full day, since the route can link Pigeon Nest Park, Tiger Stone, Lianfeng Mountain, and the Strange House Garden, each with its own admission fee.
Watch the sunrise in the morning and the sunset in the evening, and avoid the midday sun.
Peak season (summer) draws large crowds, so book hotels and popular photo spots ahead of time.
Many of the historic villas were built as sanatoriums or offices and are not open to the public — follow posted signs.

faqEn.q: Is there an entrance fee for the Beidaihe Coastal Scenic Area itself?
faqEn.a: No — the coastal area is free to enter, but most individual attractions inside, such as Tiger Stone, Pigeon Nest Park, and Lianfeng Mountain, charge separate admission.

faqEn.q: Are Beidaihe and Nandaihe the same place?
faqEn.a: No. Beidaihe is within Qinhuangdao city and is the traditional summer resort area; Nandaihe is in Changli County and focuses on amusement-park style attractions.

faqEn.q: Which months are best to visit Beidaihe?
faqEn.a: June to September is best for swimming; May and October are cooler with fewer crowds and are better for sightseeing and photography.

spots.name: 鸽子窝公园
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区鸽赤路
spots.desc: 鸽子窝公园位于北戴河海滨东北角、鸽赤路与浴场交界处，是北戴河看日出最经典的地点，“鸽子窝日出”被列为北戴河二十四景之首。公园因早年多有野鸽栖息礁石而得名，1954年毛泽东在此写下《浪淘沙·北戴河》，园内至今立有诗碑。核心景观是高约17米、形似雄鹰的鹰角石，退潮后礁石与滩涂裸露，是观鸟、赶海的好去处；园内还建有木栈道深入湿地，方便近距离观察候鸟与滩涂生物。适合摄影爱好者清晨拍日出、家庭亲子赶海观鸟，全年均可前往，夏季日出时间最早。
spots.bestSeason: 全年可看日出，夏季日出最早，但游客也最多
spots.suitableFor: 摄影爱好者、情侣、亲子家庭、早起看日出的游客
spots.tips: 看日出需凌晨到达，海边比市区体感温度低8-10℃，务必带外套 拍摄鹰角石日出建议携带三脚架，占据栈道靠海一侧机位 日出后不要急着离开，退潮时段的湿地栈道也适合观鸟和拍照 退潮时段可下滩涂赶海，建议穿防滑鞋、备好塑料袋装战利品

spots.descEn: Pigeon Nest Park sits at the northeastern tip of Beidaihe beach and is the classic spot for watching sunrise over the Bohai Sea, ranked first among Beidaihe's traditional 24 scenic views. It takes its name from wild pigeons that once nested on its rocks. Mao Zedong wrote a famous poem here in 1954, commemorated by a stone tablet. The park's landmark is Eagle Rock, an eagle-shaped outcrop about 17 meters tall. Wooden boardwalks lead through wetlands good for birdwatching and beachcombing at low tide. It suits photographers, families, and early risers.

faq.q: 鸽子窝几点看日出最好？
faq.a: 日出时间随季节变化，夏季约4:50-5:20，建议提前30-40分钟到达占位。
不同渠道报价差异较大，旺季约25元、淡季5元左右，购票前建议在线核实。
退潮时间每天不同，建议出发前查询当日潮汐表，一般在栈道下方滩涂活动。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Sunrise can be seen year-round; summer has the earliest sunrise but also the biggest crowds
spots.suitableForEn: Photographers, couples, families, and early risers who want to watch the sunrise
spots.ticketNotesEn: ¥25 in peak season, ¥5 in the off-season; ¥20 for students with ID; children under 1.2m and seniors over 70 enter free with ID (some sources instead list a flat ¥35 ticket — both figures circulate, so check what's posted on site). Prices vary noticeably between platforms (¥5-35), so verify the current price on Ctrip or Meituan before buying. It gets crowded around sunrise, so arrive early to get a spot.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Peak season (May-September): roughly 3:00-18:00, opening earlier to catch the sunrise; off-season (October-April): 8:00-18:00. Some sources instead give 5:00-18:00, so check via Ctrip or the official WeChat account before you go.

transportEn.publicTransit: Take Bus 34 from downtown Qinhuangdao, or Bus 37 within Beidaihe district, and get off at the Pigeon Nest Park stop, right at the entrance.
transportEn.driving: About 10-15 minutes by taxi from Beidaihe Station; by car, follow the coastal road (Binhai Dadao) to Gechi Road.
transportEn.parking: Parking lots are available around the park; spaces get tight in peak season, so arrive early.

tipsEn: Watching sunrise means arriving before dawn — the seaside feels 8-10°C colder than downtown, so bring a jacket.
Bring a tripod to photograph sunrise over Eagle Rock (Yingjiaoshi), and stake out a spot on the seaward side of the boardwalk.
Don't rush off after sunrise — the wetland boardwalk at low tide is also good for birdwatching and photos.
At low tide you can walk out onto the mudflats to forage for shellfish; wear non-slip shoes and bring a bag for your catch.

faqEn.q: What's the best time to see sunrise at Pigeon Nest Park?
faqEn.a: Sunrise time varies by season — around 4:50-5:20am in summer — so arrive 30-40 minutes early to get a good spot.

faqEn.q: How much is admission to Pigeon Nest Park?
faqEn.a: Prices vary a lot by channel — roughly ¥25 in peak season and ¥5 in the off-season — so it's worth checking online before you buy.

faqEn.q: When can I go mudflat foraging at low tide?
faqEn.a: Low tide time changes daily, so check the day's tide table before you go; the activity usually happens on the flats below the boardwalk.

spots.name: 老虎石海上公园
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区中海滩路
spots.desc: 老虎石海上公园位于北戴河海滨中海滩，紧邻联峰山与鸽子窝之间，因海边一组形似群虎卧滩的礁石得名，占地约3.3万平方米，是北戴河沙滩游泳和日落观赏的代表性公园。公园免费开放，沙滩坡度平缓、沙质细软，退潮后礁石区可赶海捡贝。园内设有海上飞伞、帆板、冲浪、儿童戏水池等付费娱乐项目，是国内较早建成的综合性海上公园之一。傍晚时分，夕阳映照老虎石礁石群形成剪影，是北戴河最受摄影爱好者青睐的日落机位之一。适合游泳、亲子戏水、摄影和纯散步。
highlights: 海上飞伞帆板等付费项目
spots.bestSeason: 6-9月适合游泳；全年下午4-6点适合看日落
spots.suitableFor: 全家出游、游泳爱好者、摄影爱好者
spots.tips: 退潮时可在礁石区赶海捡贝壳、小螃蟹，建议带小桶和防滑鞋 下午4-6点是拍摄老虎石日落剪影的最佳时段 夏季游泳高峰期沙滩人多，注意看管好随身物品和孩子 水上项目价格因季节和商家而异，建议现场比价

spots.descEn: Tiger Stone Sea Park sits on Beidaihe's central beach, named for a cluster of rocks resembling crouching tigers at the shoreline. Covering about 33,000 square meters, it is free to enter and one of Beidaihe's most popular beaches for swimming, with a gentle slope and fine sand. Paid activities include parasailing, windsurfing, and a children's water park. At low tide, visitors can explore the exposed rocks for shells and small crabs. Sunset here, with the tiger-shaped rocks silhouetted against the sea, is one of Beidaihe's favorite photo spots. It suits swimmers, families, and photographers.

faq.q: 老虎石海上公园要门票吗？
faq.a: 公园本身免费开放，但海上飞伞、帆板等娱乐项目单独收费。

faq.q: 老虎石和鸽子窝是同一个地方吗？
faq.a: 不是，两者都在北戴河海滨但位置不同，老虎石以游泳戏水和日落著称，鸽子窝以看日出闻名。
可以，冬季公园仍开放（约8:00-18:00），但不能游泳，适合看海景、拍照。

spots.bestSeasonEn: June to September for swimming; year-round from 4-6pm for sunset
spots.suitableForEn: Families, swimmers, photographers
spots.ticketNotesEn: The park itself is free to enter; activities inside such as parasailing, windsurfing, surfboarding, and the children's water play area charge separately. Admission is free and activities are billed per use or per time slot — check the prices posted on site.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Summer hours (April-October): 7:00-22:00; winter hours (November-March): 8:00-18:00. Some sources instead list 6:00-22:00 in summer with last entry at 21:30 — check the notices posted on site.

transportEn.publicTransit: Take Bus 34 or Bus 5 and get off at the Tiger Stone stop, right at the entrance.
transportEn.driving: About 10 minutes by taxi from Beidaihe Station; follow Zhonghaitan Road directly to the park.

tipsEn: At low tide you can forage among the rocks for shells and small crabs — bring a small bucket and non-slip shoes.
4-6pm is the best window to photograph the sunset silhouette of Tiger Stone.
The beach gets crowded during the summer swimming peak, so keep an eye on your belongings and children.
Prices for water activities vary by season and operator, so it's worth comparing on site.

faqEn.q: Is there an entrance fee for Tiger Stone Sea Park?
faqEn.a: The park itself is free, but activities like parasailing and windsurfing are charged separately.

faqEn.q: Are Tiger Stone and Pigeon Nest Park the same place?
faqEn.a: No — both are on the Beidaihe coast but in different spots. Tiger Stone is known for swimming and sunset views, while Pigeon Nest Park is known for sunrise.

faqEn.q: Can I visit Tiger Stone in winter?
faqEn.a: Yes, the park stays open in winter (roughly 8:00-18:00), though swimming isn't possible — it's still good for sea views and photos.

spots.name: 联峰山公园
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区联峰路与剑秋路交叉口
spots.desc: 联峰山公园位于北戴河区联峰路，是北戴河地势最高处，最高峰海拔约153米，林区面积约6068亩，常被称为中国第一座森林公园。山中松柏苍翠、负氧离子含量高，登顶望海亭可俯瞰北戴河海滨全景，天气晴好时秦皇岛港、鸽子窝一带尽收眼底。景区内还有莲花石、仙人洞等自然景观和多处近代别墅遗迹。由于树木茂密遮阴，夏季山中气温比山下低约5℃，是当地人纳凉避暑的好去处。适合登山、避暑、摄影和秋季赏红叶（10月前后），建议早晚时段前往，避开正午暴晒。
spots.bestSeason: 5-10月最佳，夏季避暑纳凉，10月前后赏红叶

spots.descEn: Lianfeng Mountain Park, on Lianfeng Road in Beidaihe, is the highest point in the area at about 153 meters, covering roughly 6,068 mu of pine and cypress forest. It is often described as one of China's earliest forest parks. From the hilltop Wanghai Pavilion, visitors get a panoramic view of the Beidaihe coastline. The dense tree cover keeps the park about 5°C cooler than the beach below, making it a popular summer retreat. Other sights include Lotus Rock and Immortal's Cave, plus scattered historic villas. It suits hikers, photographers, and anyone escaping the summer heat, and is known for autumn foliage around October.

faq.a: 现场票约30元左右，线上平台常有22.9元起的优惠价，建议提前在携程等平台购买。
海拔约153米，难度不大，但山路有台阶起伏，建议穿舒适的鞋。

faq.q: 联峰山秋天红叶什么时候最好看？
faq.a: 一般在10月中下旬前后，具体以当年气温和景区公告为准。

faqEn.q: When is the best time to see autumn leaves at Lianfeng Mountain?

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区东海滩路中段
spots.desc: 碧螺塔海上酒吧公园位于北戴河海滨小东山，三面环海，是北戴河东段的至高点，北邻鸽子窝公园和游船码头，南接金山嘴与老虎石公园，公园占地约106亩，因主建筑碧螺塔得名。碧螺塔建于1990年前后，塔高21米、共7层，是国内沿海地区少见的仿海螺造型观光塔，相传与“苑渠国使者乘碧螺舟东渡”的传说有关。公园白天以蓝白相间的“圣托里尼风”建筑和塔顶海景为特色，夜晚化身为北戴河的夜生活地标，设有海上酒吧、沙滩篝火、乐队演出，旺季还会举办电音派对和落日音乐会。适合情侣、年轻人及喜欢夜生活和拍照打卡的游客。

spots.descEn: Biluota (Green Snail Tower) Sea Bar Park sits on a small peninsula in eastern Beidaihe, between Pigeon Nest Park to the north and Tiger Stone Park to the south, covering about 106 mu. Its landmark, a 21-meter, seven-story spiral tower shaped like a sea snail, was built around 1990 and is tied to a local legend about envoys arriving on a "green snail boat." By day the whitewashed, Santorini-style buildings and sea views draw photographers; by night it becomes Beidaihe's nightlife hub, with beach bars, bonfire shows, live bands, and summer electronic-music and sunset parties. It suits couples, young travelers, and nightlife seekers.
highlightsEn: Nighttime bonfire and live band shows

faq.q: 碧螺塔白天和晚上都能去吗？
faq.a: 可以，白天可看建筑和海景，晚上有篝火、乐队和酒吧演出，体验不同，建议傍晚入园衔接两者。

faq.q: 碧螺塔门票包含晚上的演出吗？
faq.a: 普通门票和夜场演出套票不同，若想看篝火晚会等演出建议购买对应的夜场票种。

faq.q: 碧螺塔适合带小孩去吗？
faq.a: 白天的建筑和海景适合家庭游览，晚上酒吧氛围更适合成年人和情侣。

spots.bestSeasonEn: June to September, with the fullest experience from 4pm to 10pm
spots.suitableForEn: Couples, young travelers, and nightlife or photography enthusiasts
spots.ticketNotesEn: Adult ticket ¥48; discounted ticket ¥25 for ages 60-69; free for over-70s and children under 1.2m. Evening packages (show + views + bar experience) run about ¥80-120. Daytime and evening-show tickets are priced differently — choose based on whether you want the evening bonfire/bar show, and check current prices on Ctrip or Meituan before buying.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Regular hours 10:00-22:00, extended to 9:30-22:30 on holidays; during summer (around late June-July) hours have sometimes extended to midnight — check the day's notice posted at the site.

transportEn.publicTransit: Take Bus 15 and get off at the Biluota stop, right at the entrance.
transportEn.driving: About 15 minutes by taxi from Beidaihe Station, via Donghaitan Road.

tipsEn: Arrive around 4pm to photograph the Santorini-style architecture in daylight before waiting for sunset and the evening show.
The view from the top of the tower is the best on site, so leave enough time to climb up and take in the sea.
If you plan to attend the evening bonfire or bar show, check that day's lineup and showtimes in advance.
Summer peak season gets crowded — book online ahead of time to avoid queuing on site.

faqEn.q: Can I visit Biluota during the day and at night?
faqEn.a: Yes — daytime is for the architecture and sea views, while the evening brings a bonfire, live band, and bar performances; arriving in the late afternoon lets you enjoy both.

faqEn.q: Does the regular ticket include the evening show?
faqEn.a: No, the regular admission and the evening-show package are different tickets — buy the evening package if you want to see the bonfire show.

faqEn.q: Is Biluota suitable for children?
faqEn.a: The daytime architecture and sea views work well for families, but the bar atmosphere at night is more suited to adults and couples.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区联峰路
spots.desc: 怪楼奇园坐落于北戴河联峰路百花山一带，是北戴河风景名胜区内的经典室内奇趣景点。景区依据美国园林学者辛伯森20世纪30年代在北戴河建造的一座奇异别墅，于1991年重建而成，园名由漫画家华君武题写。怪楼建筑面积约999平方米，楼内暗道相通、楼梯与索桥交错，地板倾斜、镜面反射营造出令人眩晕的空间效果，各房间还设有不同主题的奇幻造景，被称为“999门999窗”的迷宫式建筑。因景点全部在室内，不受天气影响，是雨天备选或亲子探险的热门去处，也适合对建筑结构、光学错觉感兴趣的游客。

spots.suitableFor: 亲子探险、建筑与光学错觉爱好者、雨天备选游客

spots.descEn: Strange House Garden (Guailou Qiyuan) stands near Baihua Hill on Lianfeng Road in Beidaihe. It was rebuilt in 1991 based on a whimsical 1930s villa designed by an American landscape scholar who once lived in Beidaihe, with the park's name inscribed by cartoonist Hua Junwu. Covering about 999 square meters, the maze-like building is famous for its many doors and windows, hidden passages, tilted floors, and mirror rooms that create disorienting optical effects, each room built around a different fantastical theme. Because it's entirely indoors, it works well as a rainy-day option and is popular with families and children.
highlightsEn: Maze of countless doors and windows

faq.q: 怪楼奇园为什么叫“怪楼”？
faq.a: 因楼内多门多窗、结构错综复杂、地板倾斜、镜面反射营造出诡异空间感而得名。

faq.q: 下雨天可以去怪楼奇园吗？
faq.a: 可以，景点完全在室内，不受天气影响，是雨天出游的热门备选。

faq.q: 怪楼奇园适合几岁的孩子？
faq.a: 适合大部分学龄儿童，但内部较暗、结构复杂，建议家长全程陪同。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Good year-round, since the indoor attraction isn't affected by season or weather
spots.suitableForEn: Family adventures, fans of architecture and optical illusions, and as a rainy-day backup
spots.ticketNotesEn: Around ¥20 (sources vary between ¥15-20); prices differ slightly across platforms, so check the current price and any combo-ticket discounts on Ctrip or Meituan before buying.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: May 1 - October 31: 08:00-22:00; November 1 - April 30: 08:00-18:00.

transportEn.publicTransit: Take Bus 5 and get off at the Strange House stop, right at the entrance.
transportEn.driving: About 10-15 minutes by taxi from Beidaihe Station.

tipsEn: The interior is maze-like, so keep a close eye on children to avoid getting separated.
Some rooms have slanted floors and strong mirror reflections — take care if you're prone to dizziness or balance issues.
Since it's entirely indoors, it's a good backup on rainy or overcast days.
A visit takes about 1-1.5 hours, and it pairs well with nearby Lianfeng Mountain Park on the same day.

faqEn.q: Why is it called the 'Strange House'?
faqEn.a: The name comes from its maze of doors and windows, tangled layout, slanted floors, and mirror effects that create a disorienting sense of space.

faqEn.q: Can I visit the Strange House Garden on a rainy day?
faqEn.a: Yes — the attraction is entirely indoors and unaffected by weather, making it a popular rainy-day option.

faqEn.q: What age is the Strange House Garden suitable for?
faqEn.a: Suitable for most school-age children, though the interior is dim and complex, so parents should stay with kids throughout.

spots.descEn: Qinhuangdao Wildlife Zoo, on Binhai Avenue in Beidaihe, is one of northern China's larger wildlife parks, covering roughly 5,000 mu. It is split into a drive-through predator zone, where visitors view tigers, lions, and bears from their cars, and a walk-through zone where guests can hand-feed giraffes, alpacas, and other gentle animals, plus a bird enclosure and herbivore areas. It's open year-round, with animals generally more active in the morning and in warmer months. The zoo is a popular half-day to full-day family outing in the Beidaihe area.

faq.q: 自驾进入猛兽区安全吗？
faq.a: 猛兽区设有隔离设施，但要求全程关闭车窗、不得下车，按工作人员指示通行。

faq.q: 门票包含穿越猛兽区吗？
faq.a: 通常门票已包含观光车或自驾穿越猛兽区的费用，具体以购票页面说明为准。
常见免票标准为6岁或1.2米以下儿童，另有70岁以上老人等人群优惠，购票前建议核实当期政策。

spots.suitableForEn: Families and animal lovers
spots.ticketNotesEn: Official full-price ticket around ¥100; online platforms often show discounted prices of ¥72-80. Free admission with ID for children under 6 or 1.2m, seniors over 70, people with disabilities, and active-duty military. Booking online is generally cheaper than buying on site — book ahead on Ctrip or Meituan. Admission usually includes the safari shuttle/drive-through predator area.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Summer (April 1 - October 31): 8:30-17:30; winter (November 1 - March 31): 8:30-16:30. Open year-round, including holidays, on the same summer schedule.

transportEn.publicTransit: Take Bus 34 and get off at the Wildlife Zoo stop, right at the entrance.
transportEn.driving: About 15-20 minutes by taxi from Beidaihe Station, via the coastal road (Binhai Dadao).

tipsEn: Keep windows fully closed while driving through the predator area, and never get out of the car or feed the animals.
Visit in the morning when the animals are more active for better viewing.
In the tame-animal area you can buy feed in advance to feed giraffes, alpacas, and similar animals — a hit with kids.
The park is large with little shade in summer, so bring sun protection and plenty of water.

faqEn.q: Is it safe to drive through the predator area?
faqEn.a: Yes — the area has safety barriers, but you must keep all windows closed and stay in the vehicle, following staff instructions.

faqEn.q: Does the ticket include the drive through the predator area?
faqEn.a: Admission usually includes the shuttle or drive-through fee for the predator area — check the details on the ticket page.

faqEn.q: What age qualifies for free admission?
faqEn.a: The common threshold is children under 6 or under 1.2m tall, with discounts for seniors over 70 and others — check current policy before buying.

spots.desc: 集发农业梦想王国位于北戴河区海北路，前身为集发生态农业观光园，2018年起按照更高等级景区标准启动升级改造，是集农业科技展示、农耕文化体验、亲子娱乐和研学科普于一体的综合性主题乐园。园区内有大片热带植物温室，种植多种热带、亚热带植物和瓜果，配有农业科普展示区介绍现代种植技术；此外设有萌宠互动区可近距离接触小动物，以及多项适合儿童的游乐设施。温室环境四季恒温，是雨天和寒冷季节的理想室内游玩去处，特别适合亲子家庭和学校研学团体。

spots.descEn: Jifa Agricultural Dream Kingdom, on Haibei Road in Beidaihe, evolved from an earlier eco-agriculture park and began upgrading toward a higher scenic-area standard in 2018. It combines agricultural technology displays, farming-culture exhibits, children's rides, and educational tours for school groups. Large greenhouses grow a range of tropical and subtropical plants and fruit, alongside exhibits on modern farming techniques. A petting area lets children interact with small animals, and there are several kid-friendly rides. Because the greenhouses stay warm year-round, the park works well as an indoor option on rainy or cold days, and especially suits families and school groups.

faq.q: 集发农业梦想王国下雨天能玩吗？
faq.a: 温室区域为室内，下雨天仍可正常游览，是不错的雨天备选。
不同渠道报价在30-50元左右，建议购票前在携程/美团核实当期价格。
适合各年龄段儿童，尤其是喜欢动植物和研学科普内容的学龄儿童。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Good year-round — the greenhouses offer shade and shelter in summer and stay warm in winter
spots.suitableForEn: Families and school study-trip groups
spots.ticketNotesEn: Around ¥50 (some sources instead list ¥30; prices may shift with season or events). Prices vary considerably between sources (¥30-50) and may fluctuate with season or evening events, so check the current price and any discounts on Ctrip or Meituan before buying.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Peak season (May-December): 8:30-17:00, with last entry at 16:00. Some sources say hours extend to 21:30 during certain periods — check the day's notice posted at the site.

transportEn.publicTransit: Take Bus 5 and get off at the Jifa stop, right at the entrance.
transportEn.driving: About 15-20 minutes by taxi from Beidaihe Station.

tipsEn: The greenhouses can feel hot and humid, so wear breathable clothing and drink water regularly.
Discounted tickets are often available on Ctrip or Meituan in advance, cheaper than buying at the gate.
A half-day visit works well and can be combined with nearby attractions.
If bringing children, leave time for the petting-animal area and kids' play equipment.

faqEn.q: Can I visit Jifa Agricultural Dream Kingdom on a rainy day?
faqEn.a: Yes — the greenhouse areas are indoors, so a rainy day doesn't stop the visit; it's a good rainy-day option.

faqEn.q: How much is admission?
faqEn.a: Prices vary by channel, roughly ¥30-50 — check the current price on Ctrip or Meituan before buying.

faqEn.q: What age is it suitable for?
faqEn.a: Suitable for children of all ages, especially school-age kids who enjoy plants, animals, and educational content.

spots.name: 北戴河湿地公园
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区新河路
spots.desc: 北戴河湿地公园位于秦皇岛市北戴河区,是戴河、洋河等入海口一带形成的滨海湿地,由浅海水域、潮间滩涂、河口水域、坑塘洼地和芦苇沼泽组成,是中国城市中面积较大的湿地生态区之一。2011年启动湿地生态修复工程,2015年12月核心区域获批为国家湿地公园。这里地处东亚-澳大利亚候鸟迁徙路线的关键节点,已记录鸟类达400余种,其中包括世界濒危物种黑嘴鸥的重要繁殖地之一,享有"世界观鸟胜地"的声誉。公园内木栈道蜿蜒穿行于芦苇荡与浅滩之间,是散步、观鸟和自然摄影的好去处,尤以春秋两季候鸟集中迁徙时最为壮观。适合观鸟爱好者、摄影爱好者及亲近自然的家庭出游。
spots.bestSeason: 春秋两季候鸟迁徙期最佳,尤以9-11月秋季南迁高峰鸟种和数量
spots.suitableFor: 观鸟爱好者、自然摄影爱好者、亲子家庭、喜欢安静生态漫步的游客
spots.tips: 最佳观鸟时间是清晨或傍晚,建议自带双筒望远镜或长焦镜头 秋季(9-11月)候鸟种类和数量最多,是摄影和观鸟的黄金期 木栈道较长,建议穿舒适的步行鞋,并做好防晒/防风准备 湿地内蚊虫较多,夏季前往建议携带驱蚊用品 请勿投喂或惊扰鸟类,保持安静有助于观察到更多鸟类活动 园区内商业配套较少,建议自备饮用水和食物

spots.descEn: Beidaihe Wetland Park sits on the coast of Beidaihe District, Qinhuangdao, where the Dai and Yang rivers meet the sea, forming tidal flats, reed marshes and shallow ponds. Restoration began in 2011, and its core area was designated a National Wetland Park in December 2015. Located on the East Asian-Australasian Flyway, it hosts over 400 recorded bird species, including one of the few breeding grounds of the endangered Saunders's gull, earning it a reputation as a world-class birdwatching site. Wooden boardwalks wind through the reeds, making it popular for walking, photography and birdwatching, especially during spring and autumn migration.

faq.q: 北戴河湿地公园需要门票吗?
faq.a: 公园本体免费开放,无需购票;个别专业观鸟活动或保护区核心区域可能有单独规定,建议前往前留意现场公示。

faq.q: 什么时候去最容易看到候鸟?
faq.a: 每年9-11月秋季候鸟南迁是观鸟高峰期,清晨和傍晚是鸟类活动最活跃的时段;3-5月春季北迁季也是不错的观鸟时机。
适合,木栈道平坦好走,适合家庭漫步和自然科普,但建议携带驱蚊用品并留意脚下安全。

faq.q: 和鸽子窝公园是同一个地方吗?
faq.a: 不是。鸽子窝公园(鹰角公园)是另一处以看日出闻名的收费景区,北戴河湿地公园以芦苇滩涂和观鸟栈道为特色,两者相距不远但为不同景点。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Best during spring and autumn bird migration, especially September-November during the autumn southward peak for the widest variety and numbers of birds
spots.suitableForEn: Birdwatchers, nature photographers, families, and visitors who enjoy a quiet nature walk
spots.ticketNotesEn: The park itself is a free public ecological area with no admission fee. Specialized birdwatching or research activities in the core reserve area may require advance registration with the relevant organization — check on-site notices.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Open around the clock (the park itself has no fixed closing time); the best birdwatching windows are just after sunrise and just before sunset, so plan an early morning or evening visit.

transportEn.publicTransit: From downtown, take a bus toward the Xinhe Road area and walk from there; check current routes via Amap or Baidu Maps (search "Beidaihe Wetland Park"), since the exact bus line may change. One source mentions transferring via Bus 34, but this could not be independently confirmed — verify before you go.
transportEn.driving: Navigate to "Beidaihe Wetland Park" or "Xinhe Road"; it's about 15-20 minutes by car from Beidaihe Railway Station and Pigeon Nest Park.

tipsEn: The best birdwatching times are early morning or evening — bring binoculars or a telephoto lens.
Autumn (September-November) has the widest variety and number of migratory birds, making it the prime season for photography and birdwatching.
The boardwalk is long, so wear comfortable walking shoes and prepare for sun and wind.
Mosquitoes can be an issue in the wetlands — bring repellent for summer visits.
Avoid feeding or disturbing the birds — staying quiet helps you see more bird activity.
There are few shops or facilities inside the park, so bring your own water and food.

faqEn.q: Does Beidaihe Wetland Park charge admission?
faqEn.a: The park itself is free; certain professional birdwatching activities or the core reserve area may have separate rules — check the notices on site.

faqEn.q: When is the best time to see migratory birds?
faqEn.a: September-November during the autumn southward migration is the peak, with early morning and evening the most active times; the spring northward migration (March-May) is also good.

faqEn.q: Is it suitable for children?
faqEn.a: Yes — the boardwalk is flat and easy to walk, good for family strolls and nature education, though bring insect repellent and watch your footing.

faqEn.q: Is it the same place as Pigeon Nest Park?
faqEn.a: No. Pigeon Nest Park (Yingjiao Park) is a separate paid attraction famous for sunrise; Beidaihe Wetland Park features reed marshes and birdwatching boardwalks — they're nearby but distinct.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市山海关区天下第一关城楼(山海关古城东门)
spots.desc: 天下第一关(山海关关城)是明长城东端的重要关隘,始建于明洪武十四年(1381年),由大将徐达督建,因其一面靠山、一面临海而得名「山海关」。关城核心建筑镇远楼(俗称「天下第一关」城楼)坐落在古城东门之上,城楼上悬挂的「天下第一关」巨匾,每字约1米见方,相传为明代书法家萧显所书,是景区最具标志性的看点。游客可登城楼俯瞰关城内外及长城走势,城墙、瓮城、靖边楼、牧营楼等明代军事防御建筑保存较为完整,长城博物馆位于城楼附近可作延伸参观。景区常与「老龙头」(长城入海处)并称山海关长城的两大代表性景点,但二者为不同票种、地理位置也不同,不要混淆。适合对长城历史、明代军事建筑感兴趣的游客,以及希望登城远眺、拍照打卡的家庭和团队游客,登城楼有台阶,行动不便者需注意。
spots.bestSeason: 4-10月,尤以秋季气候最宜,天气晴朗少雨,登城远眺视野最佳
spots.suitableFor: 对长城历史、明代军事建筑感兴趣的游客;家庭亲子及摄影爱好者;行动不便者登城楼需谨慎

spots.descEn: The First Pass Under Heaven (Tianxia Diyi Guan) is the eastern terminus of the Ming-dynasty Great Wall, built in 1381 under general Xu Da. Its gate tower, Zhenyuan Tower, carries a huge horizontal plaque reading "First Pass Under Heaven," each character about one meter square, traditionally attributed to Ming calligrapher Xiao Xian. Visitors can climb the tower for views over the old walled town and the wall itself; the fortified walls, barbican, and nearby Great Wall Museum are well preserved. It is a different ticketed site from the nearby Old Dragon Head (where the wall meets the sea) and from the free-to-enter Shanhaiguan Old Town — don't confuse them.

faq.q: 天下第一关和山海关古城是一回事吗?
faq.a: 不是。山海关古城目前免费进城游览,天下第一关(镇远楼城楼景区)是古城内单独收费的5A核心景点,两者不能等同。

faq.q: 天下第一关和老龙头是同一个票吗?
faq.a: 不是同一票种,分属两个独立收费景点,如需都游览通常需购买联票或分别购票。

faq.q: 巨匾「天下第一关」是谁写的?
faq.a: 相传为明代书法家萧显所书,悬挂在镇远楼上,距今已有约600年历史,是景区最具代表性的标志。

faq.q: 登城楼需要爬很多台阶吗?
faq.a: 需要,城楼有一定高度且台阶较陡,建议穿舒适鞋具,老人小孩量力而行。

Free or discounted admission for children under 6 or 1.2m, seniors over 70, active-duty military, people with disabilities, and blood donors. Whether advance online booking is required could not be confirmed — check the official WeChat account or platforms like Ctrip/Meituan for the current policy.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Peak season (May 1 - October 31): 07:00-18:00; off-season (November 1 - April 30): 07:30-17:00 (sources vary slightly — check the official WeChat account or ticketing platform for the day's posted hours before you go).

transportEn.publicTransit: Take a train to Shanhaiguan Station, then walk about 15 minutes to the old town's east gate (First Pass Under Heaven); within the city, buses run to stops near the old town — check current routes via local transit info.
transportEn.driving: Exit the Beijing-Harbin or Beijing-Shenyang Expressway at Shanhaiguan and follow signs to the old town; about 30-40 minutes from downtown Qinhuangdao.

tipsEn: The city wall has many steep steps — wear comfortable shoes, and elderly visitors and children should take care.
The wall gets very sunny at midday in summer — visit in the early morning or evening and bring sun protection.

First Pass Under Heaven, Old Dragon's Head, and Shanhaiguan Old Town are separate attractions with separate tickets — check the exact name before buying to avoid confusing First Pass Under Heaven with Old Dragon's Head (where the Great Wall meets the sea).
If you plan to visit Old Dragon's Head or the Great Wall Museum too, compare whether a combo ticket is better value.
Peak season and holidays draw large crowds — check the official WeChat account or booking platforms for the day's opening status and reservation requirements.
The wall offers open views, great for photographing the "First Pass Under Heaven" plaque and the old town skyline — avoid the harsh midday light.

faqEn.q: Are First Pass Under Heaven and Shanhaiguan Old Town the same thing?
faqEn.a: No. Shanhaiguan Old Town is currently free to enter, while First Pass Under Heaven (the Zhenyuan Tower gate complex) is a separately ticketed 5A attraction within the old town — they aren't interchangeable.

faqEn.q: Is First Pass Under Heaven covered by the same ticket as Old Dragon's Head?
faqEn.a: No, they're separate paid attractions with different tickets — visiting both usually means buying a combo ticket or two separate tickets.

faqEn.q: Who wrote the giant "First Pass Under Heaven" plaque?
faqEn.a: It's traditionally attributed to the Ming-dynasty calligrapher Xiao Xian, and hangs on the Zhenyuan Tower — about 600 years old and the site's most iconic symbol.

faqEn.q: Are there a lot of steps to climb the city wall?
faqEn.a: Yes — the wall stands at a considerable height with fairly steep steps, so wear comfortable shoes and elderly visitors or children should pace themselves.

spots.name: 老龙头景区
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市山海关区老龙头路(山海关古城城南约5公里)
spots.desc: 老龙头位于河北省秦皇岛市山海关区,山海关古城以南约5-8公里处渤海之滨,是明长城最东端的起点,也是万里长城中唯一一段延伸入海的城墙,因城墙探入渤海、形似巨龙探首饮水而得名。景区始建于明洪武年间(1381年),后经嘉靖、万历年间扩建,加筑靖虏台、入海石城;清代长城失去军事防御作用后,逐渐成为帝王将相、文人墨客登临观海之地。1900年八国联军入侵时老龙头建筑被毁,1984年由山海关民众集资重建。景区占地约700亩,由澄海楼、入海石城、海神庙、宁海城、南海口等部分组成,融山、海、关、城于一体。最值得看的是伸入海中的入海石城(涨潮时波涛拍打城基,景象壮观)、登高望海的澄海楼(楼上悬「雄襟万里」匾),以及供奉海神信仰的海神庙。适合对长城历史、海防文化感兴趣的游客及家庭亲子出游,登城和海边步道需一定体力。
spots.bestSeason: 4-10月为最佳游览季节,气候适宜
spots.suitableFor: 长城与历史文化爱好者、摄影爱好者、家庭亲子游(需留意台阶及海边安全)
spots.tips: 入海石城靠海一侧台阶较陡且临海风大,涨潮时浪花可能打湿栈道,注意脚下防滑 夏季正午海边暴晒,建议早晚时段前往,遮阳帽/防晒霜必备 澄海楼视野最佳,登顶可俯瞰入海石城与渤海全景,建议优先游览 旺季周末及暑假客流较大,建议提前在线购票并预留2-3小时游览时间 景区内步行距离较长,建议穿着舒适的鞋子;老人小孩注意台阶起伏 海边风力较大,可另备一件薄外套

spots.descEn: Old Dragon's Head (Laolongtou) sits on the Bohai Sea coast in Shanhaiguan District, Qinhuangdao, about 5-8 km south of Shanhaiguan's old town. Built in 1381 during the Ming dynasty and later expanded, it marks the easternmost starting point of the Great Wall and is the only stretch where the wall runs into the sea. Destroyed in 1900 and rebuilt in 1984, the site now covers roughly 700 mu and includes the Chenghai Tower viewing platform, the stone sea-wall fortress (Rushi Shicheng), and the Sea God Temple. It suits history and Great Wall enthusiasts and families comfortable with stairs and coastal walking.

faq.q: 老龙头和山海关古城是一个景点吗?
faq.a: 不是。老龙头是独立景区,位于山海关古城以南约5-8公里的海边,两者门票分开,需单独购票和前往,常见做法是打车或乘公交往返。

faq.q: 涨潮和退潮哪个时间去更好?
faq.a: 涨潮时波浪拍打入海石城更为壮观,是老龙头最具标志性的画面;退潮时可以看清城基结构,但视觉冲击力较弱。建议出行前查询当日潮汐时间表。

faq.q: 门票多少钱,能不能现场买?
faq.a: 旺季门票约50元/人,淡季及线上平台常有优惠价。现场可购票,但旺季节假日建议提前通过携程、美团等平台在线购买以节省排队时间。

spots.bestSeasonEn: April to October is the best time to visit, with pleasant weather.
spots.suitableForEn: Great Wall and history enthusiasts, photographers, families with children (watch your step on stairs and near the sea)
spots.ticketNotesEn: Peak season (April-October) admission is about ¥50 per person; off-season and online group-buy or advance-booking discounts often bring it down to roughly ¥20-30, so check the posted price on the scenic area's official channels or a ticketing platform on the day. Children under 1.2m enter free; visitors over 70, people with disabilities, and active-duty or disabled military personnel enter free with valid ID; minors aged 6-18 and seniors aged 60-69 get half-price or discounted tickets with ID. Booking online via platforms like Ctrip or Meituan is recommended, especially in peak season and on holidays when it gets busy.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Open year-round 07:30-18:00 (peak and off-season hours are roughly the same, with last entry at 17:00), but check the scenic area's daily notice for the current schedule.

transportEn.publicTransit: From Shanhaiguan Old Town or Shanhaiguan Railway Station, take bus line 25 (or similar) to the Laolongtou stop, about 20-30 minutes; in summer peak season there is usually an additional tourist shuttle line, so check local bus notices for the current route.
transportEn.driving: From downtown Qinhuangdao, drive southeast via National Highway 206 or the coastal road, about 30-40 minutes; from Shanhaiguan Old Town it's about a 15-minute taxi ride (roughly 8 km) to the entrance.

tipsEn: The steps on the sea-facing side of the Rushi Stone Castle (the fort running into the sea) are steep and windy, and waves can splash the walkway at high tide, so watch your footing.
Midday sun on the beach is intense in summer, so visit in the early morning or evening and bring a sun hat and sunscreen.
Chenghai Tower has the best views — climb to the top for a panorama of the Rushi Stone Castle and the Bohai Sea, and it's worth prioritizing.
Weekends and summer holidays in peak season get crowded, so book tickets online in advance and allow 2-3 hours for the visit.
There's a fair amount of walking inside the site, so wear comfortable shoes; elderly visitors and children should watch for uneven steps.
Sea breezes can be strong, so bring a light jacket.

faqEn.q: Are Old Dragon's Head and Shanhaiguan Old Town the same attraction?
faqEn.a: No. Old Dragon's Head is a separate scenic area on the coast about 5-8 km south of Shanhaiguan Old Town. They have separate tickets, and you need to travel between them separately, usually by taxi or bus.

faqEn.q: Is it better to visit at high tide or low tide?
faqEn.a: At high tide, waves crashing against the Rushi Stone Castle create the most dramatic and iconic view of Old Dragon's Head; at low tide you can see the fortress foundation more clearly, but it's less visually striking. Check the day's tide table before you go.

faqEn.q: How much is admission, and can I buy tickets on site?
faqEn.a: Peak-season admission is about ¥50 per person, with frequent discounts off-season and on online platforms. Tickets can be bought on site, but during peak-season holidays it's best to book online in advance via platforms like Ctrip or Meituan to skip the line.

spots.name: 角山长城
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市山海关区角山路(山海关古城以北约3公里,角山景区内)
spots.desc: 角山长城位于河北省秦皇岛市山海关区,在山海关古城以北约3公里处,是明长城翻越的第一座高山,海拔约519米,故有"万里长城第一山"之称。长城依山脊而建,顺陡峭山势起伏攀升,工程之险峻在整个长城沿线中颇为少见。景区内主要看点包括长城主峰大平顶(可俯瞰山海关古城与渤海湾全景)、旱门关(明代重要军事关隘遗址)以及始建年代较早的栖贤寺。山路较陡,部分路段设有索道供体力有限的游客选择。秋季山间红叶层林尽染,与灰色城墙相映,是摄影与徒步爱好者的热门时节。整体较适合体力尚可、喜欢登高望远和长城历史的游客,亲子及老年游客建议乘索道上山。
spots.bestSeason: 9-10月秋季红叶最佳,气温适宜登山
spots.suitableFor: 喜欢长城历史与登山徒步的游客、摄影爱好者(尤其秋季);体力较弱者、老人儿童建议选乘索道上山
spots.tips: 登顶山路较陡,建议穿防滑运动鞋,体力有限或带老人小孩可选乘索道 夏季山顶日照强、山风大,建议带遮阳帽和外套 秋季(9-10月)红叶最佳但也是客流高峰,建议错峰早入园 山上补给点有限,建议自备饮用水和干粮 旺季建议提前通过在线平台购票并核实当日开放时间,避免现场排队或扑空 与山海关古城、老龙头等景点距离较近,可安排一日联游
spots.transport: 自驾:从山海关古城出发沿角山路向北行驶约3公里,车程约10-15分钟即可到达景区停车场;从秦皇岛市区出发经海阳路/长城南路转角山路,车程约40-50分钟

spots.openTimeNotes: 旺季(约4-10月)07:30-17:30,淡季时间可能缩短,建议以景区当日公告或购票平台显示为准

spots.bestSeasonNotes: 9-10月秋季红叶最佳,气温适宜登山;5-6月山花与植被葱郁也适合徒步;夏季(7-8月)高温需注意防晒防暑,冬季山路结冰湿滑需谨慎

spots.descEn: Jiaoshan Great Wall sits about 3 km north of Shanhaiguan's old town in Qinhuangdao, Hebei. At roughly 519 m, it is the first mountain the Ming-dynasty Great Wall climbs, earning it the nickname "the first mountain of the Great Wall." The wall follows a steep ridge to the summit, Dapingding, which offers panoramic views over Shanhaiguan and Bohai Bay. Other sights include the historic Hanmen Pass and Qixian Temple. A cable car is available for visitors who prefer not to hike the steep sections. Maple foliage in autumn is a particular highlight. Best suited to travelers who enjoy hiking and Great Wall history; families and older visitors may prefer the cable car.
highlightsEn: First mountain of the Great Wall

faq.q: 角山长城和山海关古城是同一个地方吗?
faq.a: 不是。角山长城在山海关古城以北约3公里的角山景区内,是长城翻越的第一座山,与古城内的天下第一关是两个独立景点,需分别购票。

faq.q: 角山长城一定要爬山吗?
faq.a: 不一定,景区设有索道可代步上山,体力有限或带老人小孩的游客可选择乘索道。
不同资料显示门票在30-40元左右,具体以景区当日公示或在线购票平台价格为准,索道费用另计。

spots.bestSeasonEn: September-October is best for autumn foliage, with comfortable temperatures for hiking.
spots.suitableForEn: Visitors interested in Great Wall history and hiking, photographers (especially in autumn); those with limited stamina or traveling with elderly family or children should take the cable car up
spots.ticketNotesEn: Sources disagree on the ticket price — some list ¥40 for an adult ticket — so check the current price and any combo tickets or student/senior/child discounts in real time on Meituan, Ctrip, or Dianping before you go. The site also has a cable car, reportedly about ¥20 round-trip or ¥15 one-way, but treat this as a rough reference only and check the price posted on site. Booking online in advance is recommended in peak season to avoid crowds.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Peak season (roughly April-October) 07:30-17:30; off-season hours may be shorter, so check the scenic area's daily notice or the ticketing platform for the current schedule.

transportEn.driving: From Shanhaiguan Old Town, head north on Jiaoshan Road for about 3 km, roughly a 10-15 minute drive to the site's parking lot; from downtown Qinhuangdao, take Haiyang Road/Changcheng South Road onto Jiaoshan Road, about 40-50 minutes.

tipsEn: The trail to the summit is steep, so wear non-slip athletic shoes; if you have limited stamina or are traveling with elderly family or children, take the cable car instead.
Sun and wind can be strong at the summit in summer, so bring a sun hat and a jacket.
Autumn (September-October) has the best foliage but also the biggest crowds, so arrive early to beat the rush.
Supplies on the mountain are limited, so bring your own water and snacks.
Book tickets online in advance in peak season and confirm the day's opening hours to avoid lines or a wasted trip.
It's close to Shanhaiguan Old Town and Old Dragon's Head, so it's easy to combine into a one-day itinerary.

faqEn.q: Are Jiaoshan Great Wall and Shanhaiguan Old Town the same place?
faqEn.a: No. Jiaoshan Great Wall is in the Jiaoshan scenic area about 3 km north of Shanhaiguan Old Town — it's the first mountain the Great Wall climbs. It's a separate attraction from the First Pass Under Heaven inside the old town, with its own ticket.

faqEn.q: Do I have to climb the whole way at Jiaoshan?
faqEn.a: No, there's a cable car available, so visitors with limited stamina or traveling with elderly family or children can ride up instead of hiking.

faqEn.q: How much does admission cost?
faqEn.a: Sources put the ticket price at around ¥30-40; check the price posted on site or on the booking platform on the day. The cable car is charged separately.

spots.name: 孟姜女庙
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市山海关区凤凰山(姜女庙路),山海关古城东约6公里
spots.desc: 孟姜女庙又称贞女祠,位于秦皇岛市山海关区凤凰山上,山海关古城东约6公里处。相传始建于宋代以前,现存主体建筑为明万历年间重修,是中国四大民间传说之一“孟姜女哭长城”的纪念地,也是河北省首批重点文物保护单位。庙依山而建,须登108级石阶方能抵达山门,沿途松柏掩映,视野可俯瞰渤海与山海关关城。正殿供奉孟姜女彩塑坐像,两侧侍女陪立;殿前楹联“秦皇安在哉,万里长城筑怨;姜女未亡也,千秋片石铭贞”运用谐音双关,被誉为“天下第一奇联”。庙后山巅有传说中孟姜女望夫痛哭的“望夫石”,以及梳妆台、振衣亭等遗迹,山下还建有仿江南园林风格的孟姜女苑,以场景形式演绎传说故事。景区规模不大,游览节奏轻松,适合对民间传说、古建筑感兴趣的游客,以及安排山海关古城、老龙头一日游行程时顺道加游。
spots.bestSeason: 4-10月,气候适宜、树木葱郁,登山望海视野最佳
spots.suitableFor: 对民间传说和古建筑感兴趣的游客、家庭亲子出行、摄影爱好者,以及山海关古城一日游顺路加游的游客

spots.descEn: Mengjiangnu Temple, also called the Temple of the Faithful Maiden, sits on Fenghuang (Phoenix) Hill about 6 km east of Shanhaiguan's old town. Said to predate the Song dynasty and rebuilt in the Ming era, it commemorates one of China's four great folk legends, in which Meng Jiangnu's weeping is said to have broken a section of the Great Wall. Visitors climb 108 stone steps to the main hall, which holds a painted statue of Meng Jiangnu and a famous punning couplet. Behind the temple, the Wangfu (Longing for Husband) Rock marks where she is said to have watched for her husband. A garden area below retells the legend through staged scenes. Allow 1-2 hours.
highlightsEn: Statue of Meng Jiangnu in main hall

spots.bestSeasonEn: April to October, when the weather is pleasant, the trees are lush, and the views from the hilltop overlooking the sea are at their best.
spots.suitableForEn: Visitors interested in folklore and historic architecture, families, photographers, and anyone doing a day trip from Shanhaiguan Old Town
spots.ticketNotesEn: Tickets can be booked online through several platforms (Ctrip, Meituan, Dahe Ticketing, etc.). The price has changed over time (it was previously ¥25); ¥30 is the price most commonly listed now, but confirm on site.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Regular hours are 08:00-17:30 (last entry 17:00); in some years, peak season (roughly May through year-end) runs 07:30-17:30, extending to 18:30 on busy holidays like Labor Day. Opening hours vary slightly by source, so call ahead or check a booking platform for the current schedule.

transportEn.driving: About a 10-minute taxi ride or drive from Shanhaiguan Old Town (roughly 6.5 km), straight to the entrance via Jiangnümiao Road.

tipsEn: It's easy to combine with Shanhaiguan Old Town and Old Dragon's Head in one day, as all are within a 15-minute drive of each other.
The 108-step stone stairway to the temple is fairly steep — elderly visitors and children should take breaks, and watch for slippery steps.
Peak season gets crowded around midday, so visit in the morning or evening, which also gives better light for photos.
It's windy at the top with good views over the Bohai Sea, so bring sun protection or something warm.
Book tickets online in advance in peak season to avoid lines.
Steps and paths can ice over in winter, so watch your footing.

faqEn.q: How much is admission to Mengjiangnu Temple?

faqEn.q: Is the ticket shared with Shanhaiguan Old Town?

faqEn.q: What are the opening hours?

spots.descEn: Ledao Ocean Kingdom is a large seaside theme park in Shanhaiguan District, Qinhuangdao, combining marine-animal shows with water and amusement rides. The park has four zones: Ocean Land, Water Land, a Miami-style area, and an ocean carnival section. Highlights include daily dolphin, sea lion and beluga whale performances, plus a summer water park with large slides and pools. The park operates seasonally, roughly late April through October, and closes for winter. It suits families with children, teenagers, and visitors interested in marine life and water play, and is a popular summer destination near Shanhaiguan.

faq.q: 乐岛海洋王国冬天开放吗?
faq.a: 不开放。景区为季节性运营,通常每年4月底至10月底开放,10月底至次年4月下旬闭园,出行前建议通过官方渠道确认具体开闭园日期。
全票约160元/人,儿童身高1.2米以下免票、16周岁以下半价,60-69周岁老人半价、70周岁以上免票,学生凭证半价,残疾人及军人凭证免票,具体以当年公告为准。

faq.q: 水上乐园什么时候能玩?
faq.a: 水乐岛(水上游乐区)仅在夏季高温时段开放,通常集中在6-8月前后,具体开放日期需查看当年景区公告。

spots.bestSeasonEn: June-August (summer break) is best — temperatures are comfortable, the water park (Water Paradise) is fully open, and the marine animal shows are in full swing.
spots.suitableForEn: Families with children, teens and students, fans of marine animals and water rides
spots.ticketNotesEn: Full-price admission is ¥160 per person, with discounts for children, students, seniors, and military/disabled visitors. Children under 1.2m enter free (with an adult); children under 16 get half price; seniors 60-69 get half price and those 70+ enter free; full-time students get half price with ID; people with disabilities and active-duty or disabled military personnel enter free with valid ID. The ticket is an all-park pass covering Ocean Paradise, the Miami-themed area, the Ocean Carnival, and the seasonal Water Paradise. The park is only open seasonally, so check the official channels or a platform like Ctrip or Qunar for whether it's open and the current price before you go, since prices and discount policies can change year to year.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Seasonal opening; for 2026: April 28-June 7, 08:30-17:30; June 8-October 31, 08:00-18:00; the park is generally closed from late October through late April the following year (check the current year's official notice).

transportEn.publicTransit: From Qinhuangdao Railway Station, take bus 8 to the Sanzhong stop, then cross the street and transfer to bus 25 to the Ledao stop. From Qinhuangdao Sidaoqiao Bus Station, take bus 25 or 35 directly to the Ledao stop. From Shanhaiguan Railway Station, take bus 25 to the Ledao stop.
transportEn.driving: Route 1: from the Qinhuangdao East exit, go straight, turn left onto Qinhuang Avenue, and follow it about 17 km to Ledao Ocean Kingdom. Route 2: from Shanhaiguan Mengjiangkou, take the Jingha connector to Guancheng South Road, turn left onto Shihe Road, then turn right at the Shihe Road/Longhai Avenue intersection and continue straight to the park.
transportEn.parking: The site has a parking lot with about 800 spaces; the reference fee is about ¥20 per visit (check the price posted on site).

tipsEn: The park is open seasonally (roughly late April to late October) and closed in winter, so confirm it's open before you go.
Water Paradise only operates in summer — bring a swimsuit, a change of clothes, and a waterproof bag if you plan to get wet.
Dolphin, sea lion, and beluga shows run on a fixed schedule posted at the entrance or on the park's official account each day, so plan your route around them.
Summer sun is intense, so bring sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water.
The park is large and spread out, so plan for a full day and think through your route between rides and shows.
Peak season (especially summer weekends) gets very crowded, so arrive early to beat the rush.

faqEn.q: Is Ledao Ocean Kingdom open in winter?
faqEn.a: No. The park operates seasonally, typically open from late April to late October and closed from late October to late April the following year. Confirm the exact dates through official channels before you go.

faqEn.q: How much is admission, and are there discounts?
faqEn.a: Full price is about ¥160 per person. Children under 1.2m enter free, children under 16 get half price, seniors 60-69 get half price and those 70+ enter free, students get half price with ID, and people with disabilities or military ID enter free — check the current year's notice for details.

faqEn.q: When can I use the water park?
faqEn.a: Water Paradise (the water play area) only opens during the hottest part of the year, typically around June-August — check the park's notice for the exact dates each year.

spots.desc: 长寿山景区位于河北省秦皇岛市山海关区,地处山海关城东北约9公里处,背倚万里长城,是以“寿”文化为主题的自然山岳型风景区,国家4A级旅游景区。景区因山势起伏、林木葱郁、多有长寿传说而得名,历代文人曾在此题写与“寿”相关的碑刻,形成独特的人文景观。景区核心看点包括悬阳洞——中国北方规模最大的天然花岗岩溶洞,洞中有洞、层叠曲折;沿山而立的寿字碑林,汇集历代名家所书“寿”字石刻数百方;神医石窟内塑有历代名医石像,记述中医药文化渊源;此外山间摩崖石刻遍布,记录历代游人题咏。景区依山而建,登山步道串联各景点,兼具自然观景与祈福养生功能。适合家庭出游、中老年游客祈寿祈福,以及喜爱登山、摄影和地质奇观的游客;因山路台阶较多,行动不便者需量力而行。

spots.descEn: Changshoushan (Mountain of Longevity) is a mountain scenic area in Shanhaiguan District, Qinhuangdao, Hebei, about 9 km northeast of the Shanhaiguan old town, backed by the Great Wall. Rated a national 4A attraction, it is themed around China's "longevity" (shou) culture. Its best-known feature is Xuanyang Cave, said to be northern China's largest natural granite cave, with chambers nested within chambers. The site also holds a "forest" of stone tablets carved with the character for longevity by historical calligraphers, a grotto with sculptures honoring famous physicians, and scattered cliff inscriptions. Suited to family visits, older travelers, hikers and photographers; the trails involve many steps.
highlightsEn: Xuanyang Cave (largest natural granite cave in N. China)

There's also a combo ticket covering Old Dragon's Head and the Shanhaiguan Old Town experience for ¥120; we couldn't find a complete price for a combo including Mengjiangnu Temple. Ctrip, Bendibao, and similar platforms list a reference price of ¥30, and there are several cross-attraction combo packages (e.g., with Old Dragon's Head and First Pass Under Heaven). We found no clear source on discounts for children, seniors, or students, or on whether advance booking is required — call the site to confirm before you go.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: May 1-December 31, 07:30-17:30 (ticket sales and entry stop at 17:00). Sources are inconsistent about winter (January-April) opening, and an older claim of year-round 08:00-17:00 hours conflicts with this, so call ahead to confirm.

transportEn.driving: By car, head northeast from Shanhaiguan for about 9 km to reach the site; about a 25-minute taxi ride from Shanhaiguan.

tipsEn: There are many steps on the mountain trails, so wear comfortable, non-slip shoes.
Xuanyang Cave is cool inside, so bring a light jacket.
Peak season runs May-December; winter (January-April) opening is uncertain, so call ahead to confirm.
Combo tickets are available covering Old Dragon's Head and First Pass Under Heaven, among others.
Mobile signal and navigation can be unreliable in the mountains, so download offline maps or directions beforehand.
Food options on site are limited, so bring your own water and snacks.

faqEn.q: How much does Changshoushan cost?
faqEn.a: Online platforms list a reference price starting around ¥30, with several cross-attraction combo packages also available — check the price posted on site on the day.

faqEn.q: Is Changshoushan open year-round?
faqEn.a: Available information shows it's open May 1 through December 31, 07:30-17:30. We couldn't find a reliable source on winter (January-April) opening or hours — call 0335-5259000 or 0335-5176633 to confirm before you go.

faqEn.q: Do I need to book in advance for Changshoushan?
faqEn.a: We found no clear information requiring advance booking — check with the site by phone or through an online ticketing platform before you go.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市山海关区石河水库(山海关城西北约3.5公里处)
spots.desc: 燕塞湖景区位于河北省秦皇岛市山海关区,地处山海关城西北约3.5公里处,是万里长城东端第一座人工湖。景区原为石河水库,1974年因筑坝截流石河而形成,石河古称渝河,历史上是山海关军事要塞的天然屏障,隋唐辽金时期的民族军事冲突、明末李自成大军与吴三桂、多尔衮清军在石河两岸的大战、近代两次直奉战争及1933年长城抗战均发生于此。1984年燕塞湖被定为河北省旅游定点单位,是秦皇岛开发较早的景区之一。湖区青山环抱、碧水一池,素有“北方小桂林”之称,两岸奇峰怪石林立、倒映水中;湖中设有鸟语林,栖息百余种珍禽。游客可乘生态游船巡游湖面,沿途可观东山剑峰等景观奇石。景区适合家庭游客、摄影与自然风光爱好者、喜欢山水人文结合的游客,秋季层林尽染时尤为热门。

spots.descEn: Yansai Lake sits in Shanhaiguan District, Qinhuangdao, about 3.5 km northwest of the old Shanhaiguan fortress town. Formed in 1974 when a dam was built across the Shi River, it became the first man-made lake at the eastern end of the Great Wall; the river once served as the fortress's natural defensive barrier and was the site of historical battles from the Sui-Tang era through the 1933 Great Wall resistance against Japan. Known as the "Guilin of the North" for its green hills and clear water, the lake offers boat cruises past unusual rock formations and a bird park with over 100 species. It is especially popular in autumn for colorful foliage.
highlightsEn: First man-made lake by the Great Wall

faq.q: 燕塞湖门票是否包含船票?

faq.q: 燕塞湖适合游玩多长时间?
faq.a: 一般建议安排2-3小时,包含乘船游湖和岸边景观游览。

faq.q: 燕塞湖和山海关古城能否安排在同一天?
faq.a: 可以,两地车程约20分钟,适合安排同日联游。

spots.bestSeasonEn: May-October is best, with summer good for escaping the heat and autumn offering the most vivid foliage.
spots.suitableForEn: Families, nature and photography enthusiasts, visitors who enjoy a mix of scenery and cultural sites
spots.ticketNotesEn: Sources disagree: some list admission at ¥90 per person, others put it from ¥50 or a group-buy price of ¥45, and we could not confirm a consistent answer on whether boat rides are included. spots.openTimeNotesEn: Peak season (roughly May-October) 08:00-17:00; off-season hours may be shorter, and sources differ on opening at 08:00 or 08:30, so check the official channels or a travel platform for the current schedule.

transportEn.publicTransit: Tourist shuttle line 3 runs directly to Yansai Lake from Shanhaiguan Old Town/Shanhaiguan Station; confirm the departure point and schedule on site or online.
transportEn.driving: About a 20-minute drive or taxi ride from Shanhaiguan Old Town (roughly 3.5 km).

tipsEn: Confirm whether the boat ticket needs to be purchased separately before boarding.
Autumn (around September-October) has the most vivid foliage and is the best time for photos and scenery.
The lake area is fairly large, so allow 2-3 hours for the visit.
The bird sanctuary (Niaoyulin) is a good stop for families with young children.
Admission and hours change with the season, so check official channels or a travel platform for the current information before you go.

faqEn.q: Does the Yansai Lake ticket include the boat ride?
faqEn.a: Sources disagree — some list admission at ¥90, others from ¥50 or a group-buy price of ¥45, and we couldn't confirm a consistent answer on whether the boat ride is included. Check with the official channels or a travel platform before buying.

faqEn.q: How long should I plan for Yansai Lake?
faqEn.a: Generally 2-3 hours, including a boat ride on the lake and exploring the shoreline scenery.

faqEn.q: Can I visit Yansai Lake and Shanhaiguan Old Town on the same day?
faqEn.a: Yes, they're about a 20-minute drive apart, making them easy to combine in one day.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市山海关区东大街1号
spots.desc: 山海关古城位于秦皇岛市山海关区，明洪武十四年（1381年）由徐达主持修建，是明长城东端的军事重镇，素有"天下第一关"之称。古城呈正方形，周长约4公里，城内保留了大量明清风格的街巷院落，钟鼓楼、兵部分司署、总兵府等历史建筑分布其中，东门箭楼"天下第一关"城楼是古城标志。古城本身免费进入，登城楼、逛兵部分司署等景点需另购票。适合喜欢历史古建、亲子研学和摄影的游客，逛完古城常与老龙头、角山长城一并安排。

spots.descEn: Built in 1381 during the Ming dynasty, Shanhaiguan Old Town sits at the eastern end of the Great Wall and was a key military pass, known as the "First Pass Under Heaven." The walled town keeps Ming-and-Qing-era streets and courtyards, with the East Gate watchtower, a bell-and-drum tower, and former military offices. Entry to the town is free; the watchtower and some historic buildings charge separate admission. It suits history and architecture fans, families, and photographers, and pairs well with Old Dragon Head and Jiaoshan Great Wall.

faq.a: 古城本身免费进入，只有登天下第一关城楼等特定景点才需要购票。

faq.q: 古城和老龙头是一个地方吗？
faq.a: 不是，老龙头是长城入海处，在古城以南约5公里，需要另外前往。
只逛街巷约1.5-2小时，加上登城楼、参观各院落约需半天。

spots.bestSeasonEn: April-October; autumn brings cooler weather and the old buildings photograph especially well.
spots.suitableForEn: History buffs, families with kids on educational trips, photographers
spots.ticketNotesEn: Entry to the old town itself is free. Climbing the First Pass Under Heaven gate tower costs ¥60. A combo ticket covering the First Pass Under Heaven, the Ministry of War Branch Office, the Bell and Drum Tower, and other sites costs about ¥50. The Arrow Tower alone is about ¥40. Walking through the old town is free; visiting the paid sites — the gate tower, the Ministry of War Branch Office, etc. — requires a separate ticket or combo pass. Children under 1.2m, seniors over 70, active-duty military, and people with disabilities enter free with ID; minors aged 6-18 and students get half price — check the ticket window for current details.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: The old town is open all day; paid sites like the gate tower are roughly 08:30-17:00 (hours shift slightly by season, so check official channels before you go).

transportEn.publicTransit: About a 15-minute walk from Shanhaiguan Railway Station to the old town; local buses also run to the Shanhaiguan Old Town stop.
transportEn.driving: Take the Shanhaiguan exit off the G1 Jingha Expressway, about a 10-minute drive to the old town; it's roughly 15 km from Qinhuangdao Station and 18 km from Beidaihe Station, and about 300 km (roughly 3.5 hours) from Beijing.

tipsEn: Walking through the old town is free; climbing the First Pass Under Heaven gate tower requires a separate ticket.
There are plenty of snack stalls and gift shops inside, so you could easily spend half a day browsing.
It pairs well with Old Dragon's Head and Jiaoshan Great Wall on the same day, since all three are close together.
Peak-season holidays get crowded — mornings and evenings are quieter and give better light for photos.
The steps up the gate tower are steep, so wear comfortable shoes.

faqEn.q: Do I need a ticket to enter the old town?
faqEn.a: No, the old town itself is free to enter; you only need a ticket for specific sites like the First Pass Under Heaven gate tower.

faqEn.q: Are the old town and Old Dragon's Head the same place?
faqEn.a: No, Old Dragon's Head is where the Great Wall meets the sea, about 5 km south of the old town, and requires a separate trip.

faqEn.q: How long does it take to see the old town?
faqEn.a: Walking the streets alone takes about 1.5-2 hours; add the gate tower and various courtyards and it's closer to half a day.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市海港区东山街
spots.desc: 秦皇求仙入海处位于秦皇岛市海港区东山一带，相传是秦始皇东巡时派方士出海求取长生不老药的地方，"秦皇岛"这一城市名称即由此传说而来。景区临海而建，园内有高约6米的秦始皇雕像、求仙殿、祈福广场和战国风情园等仿古建筑，讲述秦始皇东巡、徐福出海求仙的历史传说。景区规模不大，以历史主题小品和海景为主，是了解秦皇岛地名由来的地标性景点，适合带孩子做历史科普，也适合喜欢临海拍照的游客，游玩强度较低。

spots.nameEn: Site of Emperor Qin's Quest for Immortality
spots.descEn: Located on the coast in Haigang District, this site is traditionally linked to Emperor Qin Shi Huang's legendary quest for the elixir of immortality — the story that gave Qinhuangdao its name. The park features a roughly 6-meter statue of the emperor, a shrine-style hall, a prayer plaza, and a Warring States-themed garden. It's a small, low-key seaside park good for a short history-themed visit or photos, and works well for families doing light historical sightseeing.
highlightsEn: Statue of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

faq.a: 根据现有资料，景区已取消大门票、免费开放，但建议出行前通过官方渠道或现场确认，以防个别设施单独收费。

faq.q: "秦皇岛"这个名字和这里有关系吗？
faq.a: 有关系，相传秦始皇曾派方士从此处入海求仙，"秦皇岛"之名即源于此传说。
适合，园区不大、有雕像和主题小品，适合做历史科普和拍照，游玩强度低。

spots.bestSeasonEn: April-October, when the weather is warm and sea winds are milder, is the best time to visit.
spots.suitableForEn: History buffs, families on educational trips, visitors after seaside photos
spots.ticketNotesEn: Free (the general admission fee, previously about ¥30-45 depending on the source, has been dropped in recent years). Multiple sources say the site now has no general admission fee, though older material mentions ticket prices, half-price for children, and free entry for seniors and military. Whether individual facilities within the park are still charged separately could not be confirmed, so check the on-site notice or the official account before you go.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: 08:00-17:00, mainly open in peak season (April-October); hours for other months and the exact closing time should be confirmed in advance.

transportEn.publicTransit: Take bus 8 within the city to the Qiuxian Ruhaichu stop, right at the entrance.
transportEn.driving: About 6 km (roughly a 15-minute drive) from Qinhuangdao Station; about 18 km from Beidaihe Station; about 300 km (roughly 3.5-4 hours) from Beijing.

tipsEn: The site is small and fits easily into a half-day itinerary while exploring downtown Qinhuangdao.
It's windy by the sea, so dress warmly in spring and autumn.
The statue of Qin Shi Huang is the main photo spot.
Worth visiting if you're curious where the name 'Qinhuangdao' comes from.
There's little shade in the park, so watch for sun exposure in summer.

faqEn.q: Is there still an admission fee?
faqEn.a: According to available information, the general admission fee has been dropped and the site is free to enter, but confirm through official channels or on site in case individual facilities are charged separately.

faqEn.q: Is the name 'Qinhuangdao' connected to this site?
faqEn.a: Yes — according to legend, Qin Shi Huang sent alchemists to sea from this spot in search of immortality, and the city's name, 'Qinhuangdao,' comes from that legend.

faqEn.q: Is it good to bring kids?
faqEn.a: Yes, the site is small with a statue and themed installations, making it good for a light, low-effort history lesson and photos.

spots.name: 新澳海底世界
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市海港区河滨路81号
spots.desc: 新澳海底世界位于秦皇岛市海港区河滨路，是一座以海洋生物展示为主的室内水族馆，拥有当地知名的海底观光隧道，游客步行其间可看到鲨鱼、鳐鱼、海龟等从头顶游过。馆内还设有极地动物馆，饲养海豹、企鹅等极地生物，并定时安排美人鱼表演、海狮表演等互动节目。由于全程室内、恒温，是雨天、高温天或冬季出游的稳妥选择，也是秦皇岛亲子游、海洋科普的热门去处，适合带小朋友的家庭以及海洋生物爱好者。
spots.bestSeason: 全年皆宜（室内恒温景点，不受天气季节影响）
spots.suitableFor: 亲子家庭、海洋爱好者、雨天/高温天备选行程
spots.tips: 全室内景点，雨天、高温天或寒冷季节是很好的备选 海底隧道拍照建议用视频或连拍模式，效果更好 入园先看当天表演时间表，避免错过美人鱼、海狮表演 馆内较为拥挤时建议避开周末和节假日高峰时段 室内有空调，季节交替时可薄外套备用

spots.descEn: Xin'ao Ocean World is an indoor aquarium in Haigang District, Qinhuangdao, best known for its underwater viewing tunnel where sharks, rays, and turtles swim overhead. It also houses a polar zone with seals and penguins, plus scheduled mermaid and sea lion shows. Being fully indoor and climate-controlled, it's a reliable option on rainy, very hot, or cold days, and is popular with families and marine-life enthusiasts.

faq.a: 可以，馆内全程室内，是秦皇岛少数不受天气影响的景点之一。
馆内定时安排美人鱼表演和海狮表演，具体场次以当天入口处公示的时间表为准。
非常适合，是秦皇岛热门的亲子科普景点，1.2米以下儿童通常享受免票政策。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Good year-round (it's an indoor, climate-controlled attraction unaffected by weather or season).
spots.suitableForEn: Families with children, marine life enthusiasts, a good backup plan for rainy or very hot days
spots.ticketNotesEn: Starting from ¥55 (ticket types and prices may vary by season, so check the official channel or a booking platform for the current price). Children under 1.2m, seniors over 70, active-duty military, and people with disabilities enter free with valid ID, check the site's daily notice for details. Shows run on a limited schedule, so check the show times after entering.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: April 1-October 15: 08:40-16:30; October 16-January 31 and February 2-March 31: 09:10-16:30; February 1: 09:10-15:00 (these are ticket sales/entry cutoff times, so check the on-site notice for details).

transportEn.publicTransit: Take bus 19 or 32 within the city to the Xin'ao Ocean World stop, right at the entrance.
transportEn.driving: About 6-8 km (roughly a 15-20 minute drive) from Qinhuangdao Station; about 15 km from Beidaihe Station; about 300 km (roughly 3.5-4 hours) from Beijing.

tipsEn: It's fully indoors, making it a great backup for rainy, very hot, or cold days.
In the underwater tunnel, video or burst-mode photos tend to come out better.
Check the day's show schedule after entering so you don't miss the mermaid or sea lion shows.
It can get crowded, so try to avoid weekend and holiday peak times.
It's air-conditioned inside, so bring a light jacket for shoulder seasons.

faqEn.q: Can I visit on a rainy day?
faqEn.a: Yes, the whole experience is indoors, making it one of the few Qinhuangdao attractions unaffected by weather.

faqEn.q: Are there shows, and when?
faqEn.a: Yes, mermaid and sea lion shows run on a set schedule, posted at the entrance each day.

faqEn.q: Is it good for young kids?
faqEn.a: Yes, it's a popular family attraction in Qinhuangdao, and children under 1.2m generally enter free.

spots.name: 秦皇岛港口博物馆
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市海港区南山街13号
spots.desc: 秦皇岛港口博物馆位于海港区南山街，依托秦皇岛港百年工业遗存改造而成，是国内为数不多的以港口发展史为主题的专题博物馆。秦皇岛港始建于清末（1898年前后），是近代中国重要的煤炭输出港，馆内通过老照片、工业设备和史料展陈，讲述港口从开埠到现代化的百余年变迁。园区保留了不少工业风建筑外观，改造后兼具文创和打卡属性，很适合喜欢城市历史、工业遗址风格摄影的游客。目前对散客的参观接待方式有限，建议提前确认预约方式。

spots.suitableFor: 文化爱好者、摄影爱好者、对港口/工业历史感兴趣的游客

spots.descEn: Housed in a converted century-old industrial site in Haigang District, this museum traces the history of Qinhuangdao Port, one of modern China's major coal-export ports established around the late Qing dynasty. Exhibits combine old photographs, industrial equipment, and archival material covering the port's growth from a treaty-era harbor to a modern facility. The industrial-style buildings also make it a good spot for photography. Visiting arrangements for individual travelers are currently limited, so checking reservation details in advance is recommended.

faq.a: 据部分资料显示目前主要接待团体预约，个人游客建议提前电话或通过"乐游冀"小程序确认是否可直接入馆。
免费参观，但需要携带身份证登记。

spots.suitableForEn: Culture and photography enthusiasts, visitors interested in port or industrial history

faqEn.q: Is it open on weekends?
faqEn.a: Available information covers weekday hours only; weekend and closure schedules could not be confirmed, so call ahead to check before you go.

spots.name: 戴河生态园
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河区宁海大道北（戴河沿岸）
spots.desc: 戴河生态园（也称北戴河自然生态公园）沿戴河两岸而建，位于北戴河区宁海大道北侧，占地约185公顷，相当于颐和园面积的三分之二。园区以"阳光之美、生态和谐"为设计理念，融合江南园林的精巧与北方园林的开阔，规划有"一带三章七景区十八景点"，园内木栈道、荷花池、垂钓区、环形绿道等设施齐全，绿树成荫、河水清澈，是当地居民晨练、散步、骑行的日常去处，也适合游客在赶路间隙来放松半天。全年免费开放。
spots.bestSeason: 5-9月，夏季荷花盛开时最美
spots.suitableFor: 全家休闲、垂钓爱好者、散步骑行、行程间隙放松
spots.tips: 免费开放的社区公园，适合行程间隙来放松，不用单独预留大块时间 夏季荷花盛开（约6-8月）是最佳观赏期 带鱼竿可以在垂钓区体验垂钓 园区较大，适合骑行或散步，建议穿舒适的鞋子 园内遮荫较好，但夏季正午仍建议做好防晒

spots.descEn: Daihe Ecological Park stretches along both banks of the Dai River in Beidaihe District, covering about 185 hectares. It blends southern Chinese garden design with the open layout typical of northern gardens, offering wooden boardwalks, a lotus pond, a fishing area, and a ring-shaped path for walking or cycling. Shaded and quiet, it's a favorite spot for locals' morning exercise and a relaxed half-day stop for visitors. Admission is free year-round.

faq.a: 不需要，全年免费开放。
适合，园区平坦开阔，木栈道和绿地适合家庭散步，但园内游乐设施较少，以自然休闲为主。
夏季（6-8月）荷花盛开时最漂亮，春秋季气候舒适也适合散步骑行。

spots.bestSeasonEn: May to September, most beautiful in summer when the lotus flowers bloom.
spots.suitableForEn: Families, anglers, strolling and cycling, a relaxing break between other sights
spots.ticketNotesEn: No admission fee. A few individual activities inside the park, such as fishing or bike rental, may charge a fee — check the posted price on site (exact figures unverified).

transportEn.publicTransit: Take bus line 45 to the Daihe Ecological Park West Gate (Daihe Shengtaiyuan Ximen) stop; it's about a 13-meter walk from there.
transportEn.driving: About 6-8 km (15-20 minutes) by car from Beidaihe Station, or about 20 km from Qinhuangdao Station.

tipsEn: This free community park is a good place to unwind between other stops — no need to set aside a big block of time.
Lotus flowers are at their best from roughly June to August, the peak viewing period.
Bring a fishing rod if you want to try the designated fishing area.
The park is fairly large and good for cycling or walking, so wear comfortable shoes.
There's decent shade, but bring sun protection for midday visits in summer.

faqEn.q: Is there an admission fee?
faqEn.a: No — the park is free to enter year-round.

faqEn.q: Is it suitable for children?
faqEn.a: Yes. The park is flat and open, with boardwalks and lawns good for a family stroll, though there are few playground facilities — it's mainly about enjoying nature.

faqEn.q: When is the best time to visit?
faqEn.a: Summer (June-August), when the lotus flowers are in full bloom, is the most scenic time. Spring and autumn are also pleasant for walking or cycling.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市昌黎县黄金海岸中区（孤独图书馆位于大蒲河镇黄金海岸工业园区金海南路7号附近）
spots.desc: 阿那亚是位于秦皇岛市昌黎县黄金海岸中区的滨海生活方式社区，由封闭式住宅区与一系列公共文化建筑组成，2013年前后随"孤独图书馆"（三联海边公益图书馆）走红后成为国内最具代表性的网红海岸目的地之一。由建筑师董功设计的孤独图书馆紧邻海边、落地窗正对大海，是国内首座海边公益图书馆；园区内还有阿那亚礼堂（海边婚礼堂）、沙丘美术馆、海边市集等场所，每年举办戏剧节等文化活动。社区本身为封闭管理，非业主或非入住客人进入需通过预约或消费方式获取通行资格，孤独图书馆需单独在其微信公众号或阿那亚APP上预约参观名额。适合文艺青年、情侣和摄影爱好者，日出、黄昏时分光线最美。

spots.descEn: Aranya is a gated seaside community at Golden Coast in Changli County, Qinhuangdao, known for the "Lonely Library" (Sanlian Seaside Public Library) designed by architect Dong Gong, whose floor-to-ceiling windows face the sea — one of China's first free public libraries by the beach. The community also includes a seaside auditorium, a Dune Art Museum, and a beachfront market, and hosts an annual theatre festival. Access is restricted: non-residents typically need a reservation or to be a paying guest, and the library requires a separate booking via its WeChat account or the Aranya app. It's popular with young creatives, couples, and photographers, especially at sunrise and sunset.

faq.a: 可以，但社区为封闭管理，通常需要预约、入住社区内民宿/酒店或达到一定消费才能进入，建议提前查询当期政策。

spots.suitableForEn: Art and design enthusiasts, couples, photographers

The Seaside Library is usually free but needs an online reservation for a visiting slot. During special events such as the drama festival, some venues admit only ticket holders or owners, and day-trippers who are not staying overnight may not be able to enter freely — check the official WeChat account in advance for which venues and slots are open that day.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: The community is open to visitors all day but is a gated, privately managed area. Seaside Library visiting slots are generally 9:00 AM-5:00 PM, with a daily visitor cap on a first-come, first-served basis — check the "Seaside Library" (Gudu Tushuguan) WeChat account or the Aranya app for the current schedule.

transportEn.publicTransit: About a 30-40 minute taxi ride from Beidaihe Station. The community also runs its own shuttle, which usually needs to be booked in advance.
transportEn.driving: About 25-30 km from Beidaihe Station; about 45 km from Qinhuangdao Station; about 260 km (roughly 3 hours) from Beijing.

tipsEn: Photography is not allowed inside the library — step outside if you want to take pictures, and keep your voice down while inside.
Book your library visiting slot in advance through the "Seaside Library" WeChat account or the Aranya app — walk-ins are not guaranteed entry.
The community is gated; if you're not an owner or overnight guest, the easiest way in is usually to book a homestay/hotel within Aranya or make a qualifying purchase.
Sunrise and dusk give the best light, when the white buildings take on golden or pink tones.
Light-colored clothing tends to photograph well against the architecture here.
Access rules for some venues can change temporarily during special events like the drama festival, so double-check before you go.

faqEn.q: Can non-owners get in?
faqEn.a: Yes, but the community is gated and managed access — you typically need a reservation, an overnight stay at a homestay/hotel inside Aranya, or a minimum amount of spending to enter. Check the current policy before you go.

faqEn.q: How do I book the Seaside Library?
faqEn.a: Reserve a visiting slot online through the "Seaside Library" WeChat account or the Aranya app. There's usually a daily cap, filled on a first-come, first-served basis.

faqEn.q: Can I take photos inside the library?
faqEn.a: No photography is allowed inside, and visitors are asked to stay quiet. You can photograph the library's exterior from outside.

spots.name: 南戴河·黄金海岸
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市昌黎县黄金海岸
spots.desc: 黄金海岸位于秦皇岛市昌黎县，紧邻南戴河旅游度假区，是国内知名的天然优质沙质海岸之一，被称为"沙漠与大海的吻痕"，沙质细软、滩缓水清、潮汐平稳。海岸后方保留有连片沙丘，是国内少见的"沙漠临海"景观，园区内的国际滑沙中心是国内规模较大的滑沙场，游客可乘滑沙板从数十米高的沙丘俯冲直下，是景区最具标志性的体验项目，此外还有滑草、水上摩托、香蕉船等水陆娱乐。沙滩本身全天免费开放，滑沙中心等收费项目按季节运营、单独售票，适合年轻人、亲子家庭和水上运动爱好者。
spots.bestSeason: 6-9月，夏季气温高、适合下海玩水和滑沙
spots.suitableFor: 年轻人、亲子家庭、水上运动爱好者
spots.tips: 滑沙是这里的招牌项目，从高大沙丘俯冲滑下直冲大海，体验刺激 夏季沙子被晒得很烫，建议穿凉鞋或拖鞋 海边风大、日照强，防晒和防风外套都要备好 滑沙中心为季节性运营（约4月初至10月初），淡季前往需提前确认是否开放 水上项目（摩托艇、香蕉船等）通常另计费，参与前问清单价
spots.transport: 公共交通:可在秦皇岛长途汽车站乘直达班车前往黄金海岸；也可从秦皇岛海阳路长途汽车站或北戴河乘车至昌黎后转中巴前往；市内公交22路可达部分路段 自驾:自驾距北戴河约30公里、车程约40-50分钟；距秦皇岛站约50公里；距北京约300公里、车程约3.5-4小时
spots.ticketNotes: 沙滩免费；国际滑沙中心等项目单独售票，成人票约80元（部分渠道电子优惠价约35元，团购价约60元），儿童/老人票约50元（优惠价约35元）；海岸本身免费进入，滑沙、滑草、卡丁车等游乐项目通常含在滑沙中心门票内、一般仅可体验一次，线上购票通常比现场窗口更划算，建议提前在旅游平台比价购买。
spots.openTimeNotes: 沙滩区域全天开放；国际滑沙中心等收费项目按季节运营，参考4月初至10月初 08:50-16:30（16:00停止检票），具体以当季公告为准

transportDetail.publicTransit: 可在秦皇岛长途汽车站乘直达班车前往黄金海岸；也可从秦皇岛海阳路长途汽车站或北戴河乘车至昌黎后转中巴前往；市内公交22路可达部分路段
transportDetail.driving: 自驾距北戴河约30公里、车程约40-50分钟；距秦皇岛站约50公里；距北京约300公里、车程约3.5-4小时

tipsList: 滑沙是这里的招牌项目，从高大沙丘俯冲滑下直冲大海，体验刺激
夏季沙子被晒得很烫，建议穿凉鞋或拖鞋
海边风大、日照强，防晒和防风外套都要备好
滑沙中心为季节性运营（约4月初至10月初），淡季前往需提前确认是否开放
水上项目（摩托艇、香蕉船等）通常另计费，参与前问清单价
spots.descEn: The Gold Coast, next to the Nandaihe resort area in Changli County, is one of China's best natural sandy coastlines — fine sand, a gentle slope, clear water, and mild tides. Behind the beach lie genuine sand dunes, an unusual dune-meets-sea landscape. Its signature attraction is the International Sand-Sliding Center, one of the country's larger sand-sliding grounds, where visitors ride a board down the dunes toward the sea; jet skiing and banana boats are also available. The open beach itself is free; the sand-sliding center and other activity zones operate seasonally with separate tickets. It suits young travelers, families, and water-sports fans.

faq.a: 沙滩本身免费开放，只有进入滑沙中心等游乐项目区域才需要购票。

faq.q: 滑沙一年四季都能玩吗？
faq.a: 不是，滑沙中心为季节性运营，大致在4月初到10月初之间开放，冬季通常停业。

faq.q: 和南戴河是一个地方吗？
faq.a: 黄金海岸紧邻南戴河旅游度假区，两者地理位置相近但是不同的景区范围，常被放在同一行程中游览。

spots.bestSeasonEn: June to September, when temperatures are warm enough for the sea and sand-sliding.
spots.suitableForEn: Young travelers, families with kids, water-sports fans
spots.ticketNotesEn: The beach itself is free. The International Sand-Sliding Center and similar attractions are ticketed separately — adult tickets are around 80 RMB at the gate (some online channels list discounted prices around 35 RMB, or about 60 RMB for group deals), with tickets for children/seniors around 50 RMB (discounted to about 35 RMB online). Sand-sliding, grass-sliding and go-karts are usually included in the sand-sliding center ticket, generally good for one ride each; booking online in advance is typically cheaper than paying at the gate, so it's worth comparing prices on travel platforms first.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: The beach area is open all day. The paid attractions, such as the International Sand-Sliding Center, run seasonally, roughly early April to early October, 8:50 AM-4:30 PM (last entry 4:00 PM) — check the current season's posted hours.

transportEn.publicTransit: Direct buses run from Qinhuangdao's long-distance bus station to Gold Coast (Huangjin Haian). You can also take a bus from the Qinhuangdao Haiyang Road bus station or from Beidaihe to Changli, then transfer to a minibus. City bus line 22 covers part of the route.
transportEn.driving: About 30 km (40-50 minutes) by car from Beidaihe; about 50 km from Qinhuangdao Station; about 300 km (roughly 3.5-4 hours) from Beijing.

tipsEn: Sand-sliding is the signature activity here — sliding down the tall dunes straight toward the sea is a thrilling ride.
The sand gets very hot in summer sun, so wear sandals or flip-flops.
It's windy and sunny by the sea, so pack both sunscreen and a windbreaker.
The sand-sliding center only operates seasonally (roughly early April to early October) — confirm it's open before visiting in the off-season.
Water activities like jet skis and banana boats are usually billed separately, so ask about pricing before joining in.

faqEn.q: Is there an admission fee for the beach?
faqEn.a: The beach itself is free. You only need a ticket to enter attractions such as the sand-sliding center.

faqEn.q: Can you go sand-sliding year-round?
faqEn.a: No — the sand-sliding center operates seasonally, roughly from early April to early October, and is normally closed in winter.

faqEn.q: Is this the same place as Nandaihe?
faqEn.a: Gold Coast sits right next to the Nandaihe resort area — they're close together geographically but are separate scenic zones, often visited together on the same trip.

spots.name: 渔岛海洋温泉景区
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河新区黄金海岸中部
spots.desc: 渔岛海洋温泉景区位于北戴河新区黄金海岸中部，是一处集海水温泉、水上乐园、沙滩游乐于一体的大型综合度假区。景区拥有数十个室内外温泉池，含多种矿物质的海水温泉是其特色，夏季开放水寨、水上乐园等玩水项目，冬季则以露天泡汤为主打，形成"夏玩水、冬泡汤"的全年运营模式。园区内薰衣草庄园在6-8月花期盛放，是热门的拍照打卡点；此外还设有滑沙、夜场演艺等项目。整体定位偏向家庭和情侣的度假式游玩，游玩时间较长，适合安排一整天。
highlights: 海水温泉（含多种矿物质）
spots.bestSeason: 全年皆宜，夏季（6-8月）适合玩水和赏薰衣草，冬季适合泡温泉
spots.suitableFor: 全家度假、情侣、温泉爱好者
spots.tips: 夏季记得带泳衣，冬季也可体验室外温泉，注意保暖衣物随身携带 薰衣草花期集中在6-8月，是最佳拍照时间 门票种类较多，建议提前线上比价购买套票更划算 暑期有夜场延时开放，可安排傍晚入园避开日间高温 园区面积较大，建议安排一整天行程
spots.transport: 公共交通:北戴河站打车约40分钟可达，暂未查到直达公交线路信息 自驾:自驾距北戴河站约30公里、车程约40分钟；距秦皇岛站约50公里；距北京约300公里、车程约3.5-4小时
spots.ticketNotes: 基础成人套票线上约135元起（含入园、沙滩、滑沙滑草、水寨等基础项目）；温泉+夜演全套联票约198元；菲奢尔海景温泉单独门票约188元；线上购票通常比现场窗口便宜约20-30元，建议提前1天在旅游平台预订；票种较多（基础套票、温泉联票、夜演联票等），出行前根据需求选择合适套票。
spots.openTimeNotes: 暑期（7-8月）08:00-21:30（21:00停止入场，含夜场）；旺季（4-6月、9-10月）09:00-17:30，温泉区延长至21:00；春节、国庆等节假日开放时间延长至18:30左右，具体以当日公告为准

transportDetail.publicTransit: 北戴河站打车约40分钟可达，暂未查到直达公交线路信息

tipsList: 夏季记得带泳衣，冬季也可体验室外温泉，注意保暖衣物随身携带
薰衣草花期集中在6-8月，是最佳拍照时间
门票种类较多，建议提前线上比价购买套票更划算
暑期有夜场延时开放，可安排傍晚入园避开日间高温
