spots.descEn: Yudao is a large resort combining seawater hot springs, a water park, and beach activities at the middle of the Gold Coast in Beidaihe New District. It has dozens of indoor and outdoor mineral-rich seawater hot spring pools, water park attractions open in summer, and outdoor soaking in winter, making it a year-round destination. A lavender garden blooms from roughly June to August and is a popular photo spot; sand sliding and evening shows are also offered. It suits families and couples looking for a full-day resort-style outing.

faq.a: 开放，冬季以室外温泉泡汤为主打项目，水上乐园等玩水设施则主要在夏季运营。
薰衣草庄园花期大致在6-8月，此时段是最佳观赏和拍照时间。
基础套票通常不含温泉，温泉需另购温泉联票或单独门票，购票前建议看清票种说明。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Good year-round: summer (June-August) for water play and lavender, winter for the hot springs.
spots.suitableForEn: Family getaways, couples, hot-spring enthusiasts
spots.ticketNotesEn: The basic adult package starts around 135 RMB online (covers park entry, beach, sand/grass sliding, water fort and other basic attractions). A combined hot spring + night show ticket is about 198 RMB. The standalone Feishe'er Seaview Hot Spring ticket is about 188 RMB. Booking online is typically 20-30 RMB cheaper than at the gate, so book a day ahead on a travel platform if possible. There are several ticket types (basic package, hot spring combo, night show combo, etc.), so pick the one that matches your plans.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Summer season (July-August): 8:00 AM-9:30 PM (last entry 9:00 PM), including the night session. Peak season (April-June, September-October): 9:00 AM-5:30 PM, with the hot spring area open until 9:00 PM. Hours are extended to around 6:30 PM during holidays like Spring Festival and National Day — check the day's posted schedule.

transportEn.publicTransit: About a 40-minute taxi ride from Beidaihe Station; no direct bus route information found.
transportEn.driving: About 30 km (40 minutes) by car from Beidaihe Station; about 50 km from Qinhuangdao Station; about 300 km (roughly 3.5-4 hours) from Beijing.

tipsEn: Bring a swimsuit in summer; in winter you can still enjoy the outdoor hot springs, so pack warm clothing to wear between soaks.
The lavender is in bloom roughly June to August, the best time for photos.
There are several ticket types — comparing prices online in advance usually gets you a better package deal.
The park stays open late in summer, so consider arriving in the evening to avoid the daytime heat.
The grounds are large, so plan for a full day.

faqEn.q: Are the hot springs open in winter?
faqEn.a: Yes — outdoor hot spring soaking is the main winter draw, while the water park facilities mainly run in summer.

faqEn.q: When does the lavender bloom?
faqEn.a: The lavender garden generally flowers from June to August, the best time to see and photograph it.

faqEn.q: Does the ticket include the hot springs?
faqEn.a: The basic package usually doesn't include the hot springs — you'll need a separate hot spring combo ticket or standalone ticket, so check the ticket details before buying.

spots.name: 圣蓝海洋公园
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市昌黎县大蒲河镇昌海大道3号
spots.desc: 圣蓝海洋公园位于秦皇岛市昌黎县大蒲河镇昌海大道，是集海洋动物展演、海底观光、亲子游乐和沙滩戏水于一体的综合性海洋主题公园。园内设有海豚、白鲸表演剧场，可近距离观看驯养员与海洋哺乳动物的互动表演；此外还有海底隧道式观光通道、4D影院及多项适合儿童的游乐设施。景区紧邻沙滩，夏季可结合海水浴场一起游玩。最值得看的是海豚剧场和白鲸表演，场次有限、人气高，是南戴河片区亲子游的热门去处，适合带孩子的家庭以及海洋动物爱好者。
spots.bestSeason: 4-10月，尤其是6-8月表演场次多、可同时玩水
spots.suitableFor: 亲子家庭、海洋动物爱好者
spots.tips: 入园后先查看当日表演时间表，海豚剧场和白鲸表演场次有限，建议提前占座。 门票价格在不同平台差异较大，建议提前在携程、美团等平台比价购买。 夏季可结合园内沙滩戏水一起安排，注意携带防晒和泳装。 开放时间随季节调整，出行前建议电话或在购票平台确认当日时间。
spots.transport: 公共交通:暂未查到明确的公交线路信息，建议从北戴河或昌黎县城乘出租车/网约车前往。 自驾:从北戴河新区打车约30分钟可达；从秦皇岛市区自驾约1小时。
spots.ticketNotes: 成人票在不同平台价格不同，官方标价约88元起，网络平台常见折扣票58元起；70周岁以上老人免费；60-69周岁老人享优惠；身高1.2米以下或6周岁以下儿童免费；残疾人、军人、学生等另有优惠政策，具体以景区当日公示及购票平台说明为准。
spots.openTimeNotes: 淡旺季不同：7月1日-8月31日 08:10-18:00；9月1日-9月30日 08:40-17:30；园内游乐设备及场馆17:00停止运营，沙滩开放09:30-17:00（出口17:20关闭）。其余月份开放时间未查到确切数据，建议出行前在官方平台确认。

transportDetail.publicTransit: 暂未查到明确的公交线路信息，建议从北戴河或昌黎县城乘出租车/网约车前往。
transportDetail.driving: 从北戴河新区打车约30分钟可达；从秦皇岛市区自驾约1小时。

tipsList: 入园后先查看当日表演时间表，海豚剧场和白鲸表演场次有限，建议提前占座。
门票价格在不同平台差异较大，建议提前在携程、美团等平台比价购买。
夏季可结合园内沙滩戏水一起安排，注意携带防晒和泳装。
开放时间随季节调整，出行前建议电话或在购票平台确认当日时间。
spots.descEn: Shenglan Ocean Park is a marine-themed park in Dapuhe, Changli County, Qinhuangdao, combining animal shows, an underwater viewing tunnel, a 4D theater and family rides. Its dolphin and beluga whale shows are the main draw, with trainers performing close-up interactions with the animals. The park sits next to a beach, making it easy to combine with seaside play in summer. It suits families with children and marine-life enthusiasts; show times are limited, so arriving early for a good seat is recommended.

faq.q: 圣蓝海洋公园门票包含表演吗？
faq.a: 门票通常包含海豚、白鲸等常规表演场次，具体以当日公示的场次时间为准。
搜索到的公开资料仅覆盖7-9月的开放时间，冬季是否正常开放及具体时间未查到确切信息，建议出行前致电或在购票平台确认。
园内以海洋动物表演和亲子游乐设施为主，适合各年龄段儿童，1.2米以下/6周岁以下儿童可享免票。

spots.bestSeasonEn: April to October, especially June to August when there are more shows and you can combine it with water play.
spots.suitableForEn: Families with children, marine-animal enthusiasts
spots.ticketNotesEn: Adult ticket prices vary by platform — the official list price starts around 88 RMB, with online discount tickets commonly available from about 58 RMB. Free for seniors 70 and over; discounted for seniors 60-69; free for children under 1.2 m tall or under 6 years old. Additional discounts exist for people with disabilities, military personnel, and students — check the day's posted price and the booking platform for details.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Hours vary by season: July 1-August 31, 8:10 AM-6:00 PM; September 1-30, 8:40 AM-5:30 PM. Rides and indoor venues close at 5:00 PM; the beach is open 9:30 AM-5:00 PM (exit closes at 5:20 PM). Hours for the rest of the year were not found — confirm on the official platform before visiting.

transportEn.publicTransit: No clear direct bus route found — it's best to take a taxi or ride-hailing car from Beidaihe or Changli county town.
transportEn.driving: About a 30-minute taxi ride from the new Beidaihe district; about 1 hour by car from downtown Qinhuangdao.

tipsEn: Check the day's show schedule as soon as you enter — dolphin and beluga whale shows have limited seating, so get there early to grab a spot.
Ticket prices vary a lot by platform, so compare prices on sites like Ctrip or Meituan before booking.
In summer you can combine your visit with the park's beach — bring sunscreen and swimwear.
Opening hours change with the season, so call ahead or check the booking platform for the current day's hours.

faqEn.q: Does the ticket include the animal shows?
faqEn.a: Tickets generally include regular dolphin and beluga whale shows — check the posted show times for the day you visit.

faqEn.q: Is it open in winter?
faqEn.a: The information found only covers hours for July-September; winter opening status and hours were not confirmed, so call ahead or check the booking platform before visiting.

faqEn.q: What ages is it suitable for?
faqEn.a: The park focuses on marine animal shows and family-friendly rides, suitable for children of all ages, with free entry for those under 1.2 m tall or under 6 years old.

spots.name: 碣石山
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市昌黎县城北碣石山
spots.desc: 碣石山位于秦皇岛市昌黎县城北，主峰仙台顶海拔695米，是华北地区少有的濒海高山，也是中国古代帝王祭海巡狩的名山。东汉末年曹操北征乌桓凯旋途中登临此山，写下"东临碣石，以观沧海"的名句，山上至今立有"曹操观海处"石刻。此外秦始皇、汉武帝、隋炀帝、唐太宗等多位帝王均曾登临碣石山祭海求仙，山中留有水岩寺、碣石门等古迹。登顶仙台顶可俯瞰渤海及昌黎黄金海岸，天气晴好时视野开阔。景区以登山览胜、访古怀今为主，适合喜欢历史文化和户外登山的游客，全程登顶约需2小时，有一定体力要求。
spots.bestSeason: 4-10月，秋季天气晴朗时登高望远视野最佳
spots.suitableFor: 登山爱好者、历史文化爱好者
spots.tips: 登山全程约2小时，需一定体力，建议穿舒适的运动鞋。 山上商店较少，自备饮用水和干粮。 登顶后视野开阔可远眺渤海，建议选择晴天前往。 秋季气候凉爽、能见度较高，是登高望远的较佳时段。

spots.descEn: Jieshi Mountain, north of Changli County, rises to 695 meters at its main peak, Xiantai Ding. It is one of the few mountains near the Bohai coast that Chinese emperors historically climbed to worship the sea, most famously Cao Cao, who wrote his poem "Gazing at the Sea from Jieshi" here after a campaign in 207 CE. Qin Shi Huang, Emperor Wu of Han and other rulers also visited. The mountain holds old temple ruins and stone inscriptions, and the summit offers views over the Bohai Sea and Changli's Golden Coast. It suits hikers and history enthusiasts; reaching the top takes about two hours on foot.

faq.a: 公开资料显示门票约20元，个别平台标价24元，建议以景区当日公示为准。

faq.q: 登顶大概需要多长时间？
faq.a: 全程步行登顶约需2小时，山路有一定坡度，需适度体力。

faq.q: 山上有没有吃饭、补给的地方？
faq.a: 山上商店较少，建议自带水和干粮。

spots.bestSeasonEn: April to October, with autumn's clear skies offering the best views from the summit.
spots.suitableForEn: Hikers, history and culture enthusiasts
spots.ticketNotesEn: 20 RMB; some sources list 24 RMB. No clear published discount policy for seniors, children or students was found — check with Ctrip or a similar platform, or at the ticket office, for the latest pricing and combo tickets.

There are few shops on the mountain, so bring your own water and snacks.
The summit offers wide views out to the Bohai Sea — pick a clear day for the best visibility.
Autumn brings cool weather and better visibility, making it a good time for the climb.

faqEn.q: How long does it take to reach the summit?
faqEn.a: The full hike to the top takes about 2 hours; the trail has a fair bit of incline, so some fitness is needed.

faqEn.q: Are there places to eat or resupply on the mountain?
faqEn.a: There are few shops on the mountain, so bring your own water and food.

spots.name: 蔚蓝海岸
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河新区蔚蓝海岸
spots.desc: 蔚蓝海岸是秦皇岛北戴河新区一处近年兴起的文艺海滨社区，紧邻南戴河，以"猫的天空之城"概念书店、海边秋千和冲浪体验为主要打卡点。这里没有大型景区式的收费入口，本质上是一片开放式的海滨生活区，沙滩相对干净、游客密度低于传统的北戴河海滨，氛围更安静休闲。猫的天空之城书店集合书籍、咖啡、文创产品，并提供"寄给未来的自己"明信片服务，是社交媒体上的热门拍照地；海边秋千在黄昏时分出片效果尤佳。适合喜欢安静度假、摄影打卡和文艺氛围的游客，尤其受情侣和年轻游客青睐。
spots.bestSeason: 5-10月，夏季适合海边活动，傍晚时段光线最佳
spots.suitableFor: 文艺青年、情侣、摄影爱好者
spots.tips: 猫的天空之城书店可以购买明信片寄给未来的自己，是热门体验项目。 海边秋千建议黄昏时段前往，光线和背景更适合拍照。 相比传统北戴河海滨，这里人少、更安静，适合悠闲漫步。 冲浪等水上项目建议提前联系当地商户确认价格和时段。

spots.descEn: Weilan Coast is a newer, low-key seaside community in Beidaihe New District, next to Nandaihe, known for the "Bookstore of the Sky" (Mao de Tiankong Zhicheng) concept bookstore, beach swings and surfing. There is no single ticketed entrance — it functions as an open coastal area with a quieter, less crowded beach than the traditional Beidaihe waterfront. The bookstore offers books, coffee, and a postcard-to-your-future-self service, and is popular for photos, especially at dusk near the beach swings. It suits couples, photography fans and travelers looking for a relaxed, artsy alternative to the busier beach resorts.

faq.a: 公共海滨区域免费开放，园区内书店、冲浪等具体项目单独收费。

faq.q: 和阿那亚是同一个地方吗？
faq.a: 不是，阿那亚是昌黎黄金海岸另一处知名文旅社区，与北戴河新区的蔚蓝海岸是不同项目，容易混淆，出行前请确认目的地名称。
整体氛围安静休闲，沙滩适合亲子漫步，但缺乏大型游乐设施，更适合以拍照、休闲为主的家庭。

spots.bestSeasonEn: May to October, good for beach activities in summer, with the best light in the evening.
spots.suitableForEn: Art and design enthusiasts, couples, photographers
spots.ticketNotesEn: Free to enter (it's a public stretch of coastline); individual attractions like the bookstore or surfing lessons charge separately. There's no admission fee for the area itself — spending at the bookstore, surf lessons, dining, etc. is priced individually by each vendor, and no single published rate list was found.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: The public seafront area is open all day. Business hours for shops such as the Sky of the City Cat bookstore follow each store's own posted schedule — no specific hours were found.

transportEn.publicTransit: No direct bus route found — take a taxi or ride-hailing car from Beidaihe Station.
transportEn.driving: About a 20-minute taxi ride from Beidaihe Station.

tipsEn: The Sky of the City Cat bookstore sells postcards you can send to your future self — a popular thing to do here.
Visit the beach swing at dusk for the best light and backdrop for photos.
Compared with the traditional Beidaihe seafront, this spot is quieter and less crowded, good for an unhurried stroll.
For surfing and other water activities, contact the local vendor ahead of time to confirm pricing and schedule.

faqEn.q: Is there an admission fee for Weilan Coast?
faqEn.a: The public seafront area is free; individual attractions like the bookstore or surfing are charged separately.

faqEn.q: Is this the same place as Aranya?
faqEn.a: No. Aranya is a separate, well-known lifestyle community on the Changli Gold Coast, while Weilan Coast is a different project in the new Beidaihe district — the two are easy to mix up, so double-check your destination name before heading out.

faqEn.q: Is it good for a visit with children?
faqEn.a: The overall vibe is quiet and relaxed, and the beach is fine for a family stroll, but there aren't major rides or attractions — it suits families more interested in photos and a low-key visit.

spots.name: 仙螺岛
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市抚宁区南戴河旅游度假区环海路1号
spots.desc: 仙螺岛是秦皇岛南戴河旅游度假区标志性的海岛景区，位于河北省秦皇岛市抚宁区南戴河环海路。游客需乘坐长约1038米的跨海索道往返海岸与海岛之间，单程约15分钟，是景区最大的特色项目，索道全程可俯瞰碧海金沙的海岛全景。岛上设有观海长廊及多种海上游乐项目，如海上蹦极、游船、旋转出租车、豪华转马、海盗船等，多数需另行付费。景区整体以"跨海索道+海岛观光+海上游乐"为核心体验，是南戴河片区的必打卡景点之一，适合全家出游、情侣及喜欢拍照打卡的游客，恐高人群乘坐索道需谨慎。
spots.bestSeason: 5-10月，夏季适合海上游乐项目
spots.suitableFor: 全家出游、情侣、拍照打卡
spots.tips: 跨海索道是最大亮点，也是登岛的主要方式，恐高者需谨慎乘坐。 岛上海上蹦极、游船等项目均需单独付费，预算游玩项目时需留出额外费用。 建议选择晴天前往，海景视野和拍照效果更好。 索道往返约15分钟，出行前留出足够的排队和候乘时间。

spots.descEn: Xianluo Island is a landmark island scenic area in the Nandaihe resort district of Funing, Qinhuangdao. Visitors reach the island via a roughly 1,038-meter cross-sea cable car (about 15 minutes each way), which offers panoramic views of the coastline. The island has a seaside viewing promenade and several paid attractions, including sea bungee jumping, boat rides, a rotating car ride, a carousel and a pirate ship. The cable car crossing is the main highlight and makes this a popular stop in Nandaihe, suited to families, couples and photo-focused visitors; those afraid of heights should be cautious on the cable car.

faq.q: 仙螺岛门票包含哪些项目？
faq.a: 门票通常含跨海索道往返，蹦极、游船、各类游乐设施等均需现场单独购票。

faq.q: 索道安全吗？恐高能坐吗？

faqEn.q: What does the Xianluo Island ticket include?
faqEn.a: It usually includes the round-trip cable car across the sea; bungee jumping, boat rides and other rides are bought separately on-site.

faqEn.q: Is the cable car safe? Can people afraid of heights ride it?
faqEn.a: It's a standard sightseeing cable car across the sea and is generally considered safe, but since the whole ride is suspended above open water, those afraid of heights should decide for themselves whether to ride.

faqEn.q: Is it open in winter?
faqEn.a: The published hours found only cover July-December; opening status and hours for winter (January-June) were not confirmed, so check ahead.

spots.descEn: Nandaihe International Amusement Center, in the Nandaihe resort area of Funing, Qinhuangdao, is one of the region's older and larger amusement parks, built around roller coasters, a Ferris wheel and a water park. With a large footprint and a mix of thrill rides and family-friendly attractions, it suits both younger visitors seeking excitement and families with children. Lines can be long during peak summer weekends, so an early, weekday visit is recommended.

spots.desc: 祖山风景区位于河北省秦皇岛市青龙满族自治县，渤海北岸、燕山南麓，主峰天女峰海拔1428米，素有"塞北小黄山""北方群山之祖"之称，是国家级风景名胜区、国家地质公园。景区原始森林覆盖率高，负氧离子浓度大，春季杜鹃花漫山遍野，夏季清凉避暑，秋季红叶层林尽染，冬季可见雾凇冰挂，四季景观各异，云海日出是天女峰最负盛名的景观。景区主要看点包括天女峰、十里画廊、画廊谷、情人谷等，步道以山地徒步和索道观光结合。适合登山爱好者、摄影爱好者及夏季避暑的游客，体力一般者可选择乘坐索道上山、步行下山。

spots.descEn: Zushan Scenic Area lies in Qinglong Manchu Autonomous County, Qinhuangdao, on the southern slope of the Yan Mountains near the Bohai coast. Its main peak, Tiannv Feng, rises to 1,428 meters and is nicknamed the "Little Huangshan of the north" for its forested peaks and sea of clouds at sunrise. The area is a national scenic and geological park with old-growth forest, azaleas in spring, cool summer air, red foliage in autumn and rime ice in winter. Highlights include Tiannv Feng peak, the Ten-Li Gallery and Gallery Valley. It suits hikers and photographers; visitors with average fitness often take the cable car up and walk down.

faq.q: 看云海日出需要怎么安排？

spots.suitableForEn: Hikers, photographers, summer-getaway travelers

Admission + shuttle bus combo is 120 RMB; admission + shuttle + one-way cable car is 160 RMB; admission + shuttle + round-trip cable car is 210 RMB. Cable car alone: 80 RMB one-way, 130 RMB round-trip. A winter special (December-February) combo of admission + shuttle is 19.9 RMB. Autumn brings the best fall foliage, a favorite time for photographers; the spring azalea blooms are also worth a special trip.

faqEn.q: How much does admission to Zushan cost?

faqEn.q: How should I plan a visit to see the sea of clouds at sunrise?
faqEn.a: Stay overnight at a guesthouse at the foot of the mountain and set off around 4:00 AM to reach Tiannv Peak in time for sunrise.

faqEn.q: Can you visit in winter?
faqEn.a: Yes — a winter special ticket (19.9 RMB, admission + shuttle) is available December-February, but check with the site in advance about cable car operation and trail access.

spots.name: 冰塘峪大峡谷
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市抚宁区大新寨镇冰塘峪（梁家湾村）
spots.desc: 冰塘峪大峡谷（全名冰塘峪长城风情大峡谷）位于河北省秦皇岛市抚宁区大新寨镇梁家湾村，坐落在明长城脚下，因峡谷夏季三伏天仍有残冰不化而得名，是北方地区较为罕见的地质奇观。峡谷两侧可见明长城遗迹蜿蜒而过，谷内溪流潺潺，并建有约200米长的悬崖玻璃栈道，惊险刺激；此外还有峡谷漂流项目，适合夏季戏水降温。景区整体以避暑纳凉、峡谷探险和长城人文为特色，夏季谷内气温明显低于谷外，是当地知名的避暑目的地，也吸引了不少外国游客前来体验。适合探险爱好者、亲子家庭以及夏季避暑的游客，恐高人群需谨慎体验玻璃栈道。
spots.bestSeason: 6-8月夏季，可同时看冰瀑奇观和避暑纳凉

spots.descEn: Bingtangyu Great Wall Canyon sits at the foot of the Ming Great Wall in Liangjiawan village, Funing District, Qinhuangdao. It is named for patches of ice that reportedly survive in the canyon even during the hottest summer days, an unusual sight for a site at this latitude. Great Wall ruins run along the canyon's ridges, and the site features a roughly 200-meter glass skywalk over the cliffs plus a river-rafting activity. The canyon stays noticeably cooler than the surrounding area in summer, making it a popular local escape from the heat and drawing a growing number of international visitors. It suits adventure seekers, families and anyone looking to cool off in summer; the glass skywalk may not suit those afraid of heights.

faq.a: 因峡谷内在三伏天仍有残冰不化的地质现象而得名，是当地较为罕见的自然奇观。

spots.suitableForEn: Adventure seekers, families, and visitors escaping the summer heat.

tipsEn: Summer is the best time to visit — the canyon runs about 10°C (18°F) cooler than outside, making it a great spot to beat the heat.
The glass skywalk hangs over a sheer cliff face, so visitors afraid of heights should think carefully before trying it.
Canyon rafting will get your clothes wet, so bring a change of clothing.
Ticket prices and opening hours shift with the season — call the scenic area or check a booking platform for the current day's information before you go.

faqEn.q: Why is it called Bingtangyu ("Ice Pond Valley")?
faqEn.a: The name comes from patches of ice that remain in the canyon even during the hottest days of summer — a fairly rare geological phenomenon in the region.

faqEn.q: Is the glass skywalk safe?
faqEn.a: The skywalk is a standard sightseeing attraction and is considered safe, but it is built along a sheer cliff, so visitors with a fear of heights should judge for themselves whether to try it.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市海港区驻操营镇板厂峪村
spots.desc: 板厂峪长城景区（板厂峪长城文化公园）位于河北省秦皇岛市海港区驻操营镇板厂峪村，距秦皇岛市区约29公里，是明代修筑长城时的"后勤基地"，因发现全国规模最大的明代长城砖窑遗址群而闻名。2002年在此出土约600座明代砖窑遗址，同时还发现了世界上唯一的"斑鬣狗"化石，景区内设有相关化石展览。园区内长城因山势起伏形成独特的"倒挂长城"段，险峻壮丽，是长城摄影爱好者的重要取景地；此外还有天然寺、灵仙洞、一线天、九道缸瀑布等自然人文景点。秋季红叶与古长城交相辉映，景色尤佳。景区是省级风景名胜区，也是世界徒步协会健走基地，适合长城爱好者、摄影爱好者和对明代军事、考古历史感兴趣的游客。

spots.descEn: Banchangyu Great Wall Scenic Area sits about 29 km from downtown Qinhuangdao in a village that served as a logistics base for Ming-dynasty Great Wall construction. Excavations in 2002 uncovered roughly 600 Ming-era brick kilns used to fire wall bricks — the largest such find in China — along with the world's only known fossil of a hyena species, now displayed on site. A steep, undulating stretch of wall known as the "inverted Great Wall" is a favorite subject for photographers, and the park also has a temple, a cave, a narrow rock passage and waterfalls. Autumn foliage against the old wall is a particular highlight. It suits Great Wall enthusiasts, photographers and visitors interested in Ming-era military history and archaeology.
highlightsEn: Ming Great Wall brick kiln ruins

faq.q: 板厂峪长城和山海关长城是同一个地方吗？

faqEn.q: Is Banchangyu Great Wall the same as the Great Wall at Shanhaiguan?

faqEn.q: Is the "Upside-Down Great Wall" section easy to walk?

spots.descEn: Tianma Lake Scenic Area sits about 9 km north of Funing District, Qinhuangdao, centered on a reservoir with a horse-shaped landmark sculpture on its shore. It historically offered boating, fishing and simple water rides for family outings. As of recent reports (2025), the site has been temporarily closed with no confirmed reopening date, so visitors should verify its status before planning a trip.

faq.q: 天马湖景区现在还能去吗？

当前无法确认现行票价；历史资料显示门市价约10元，1.2米以下儿童及现役军人免票，仅供参考。

faq.q: 附近有其他类似景区吗？
faq.a: 抚宁区及周边有天马山、老君顶、龙云谷等山水类景区可作为替代选择。

transportEn.driving: From downtown Qinhuangdao, take the Jingshen Expressway to National Highway 102 into Funing District, then head north about 9 km; the full trip takes roughly 40 minutes. The area is near the Jingshen Expressway and National Highway 102.

tipsEn: This scenic area is currently closed — call ahead or check online to confirm whether it has reopened before making the trip.
If it has reopened, historical accounts suggest the site is small and can be seen in 1-2 hours.
It can be combined with nearby Tianma Mountain and Laojunding, if you're building an itinerary around the area.

faqEn.q: Is Tianma Lake Scenic Area still open?

faqEn.q: How much do tickets cost?
faqEn.a: The current price cannot be confirmed. Historical records show a listed price of about ¥10, with free admission for children under 1.2 m and active-duty military personnel — for reference only.

faqEn.q: Are there similar attractions nearby?
faqEn.a: Funing District and the surrounding area have alternatives such as Tianma Mountain, Laojunding, and Longyungu, all nature-based scenic spots.

spots.name: 葡萄沟
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市昌黎县十里铺乡西山场村
spots.desc: 昌黎葡萄沟位于昌黎县城西北偏北约7.2公里的十里铺乡西山场村，是国家3A级旅游景区、国家级农业旅游示范点。景区依托当地百年葡萄种植传统而成，园内百年老葡萄架长廊遮天蔽日，种植巨峰、玫瑰香等多个鲜食葡萄品种。每年7月至11月为采摘期，9月前后集中成熟，游客可入园采摘、品尝，也可沿葡萄架长廊漫步拍照。昌黎同时是中国葡萄酒之乡，周边分布多家酒庄，适合与酒庄游览、亲子农事体验结合安排。
spots.bestSeason: 8-9月葡萄成熟季（4-10月均可游览田园风光）
spots.suitableFor: 亲子家庭、田园休闲爱好者
spots.tips: 最佳采摘期为8-9月葡萄成熟季，7-11月均有不同品种可采摘品尝 景区免费开放，但入园采摘葡萄通常按斤另行付费，建议提前问清价格 可与附近华夏庄园、金士国际葡萄酒庄等酒庄组合游览，体验完整的葡萄酒文化线路 夏秋季昌黎日照较强，建议做好防晒并穿轻便鞋子方便走田间小路 园区内农户较多，建议货比三家，旺季周末人流较大

spots.ticketNotes: 景区本身免费入园；进入具体采摘园区采摘葡萄按重量或按园区规则另行收费，价格因摊位而异，建议现场与农户确认。

spots.descEn: Changli Grape Valley lies about 7.2 km northwest of Changli county town, a national 3A-rated agricultural tourism site built around century-old grape trellises. Visitors can walk the shaded vine corridors and pick and taste several fresh-eating grape varieties from July through November, peaking in September. As Changli is known as China's wine town, the valley pairs well with a visit to a nearby winery for a full day of vineyard-themed sightseeing.

faq.a: 景区本身免费开放，全天不限时段，但入园采摘葡萄一般按重量另行收费。

faq.q: 什么时候去能采摘到葡萄？
faq.a: 采摘季一般为7月至11月，其中8-9月是多数品种集中成熟、体验最好的时段。

faq.q: 附近有酒庄可以一起玩吗？
faq.a: 昌黎是中国葡萄酒之乡，附近有华夏庄园、金士国际葡萄酒庄等酒庄，可以安排在同一天游览。

spots.bestSeasonEn: August to September for the grape harvest, though the countryside scenery is pleasant April through October.
spots.suitableForEn: Families and anyone who enjoys a relaxed rural outing.
spots.ticketNotesEn: Admission to the scenic area itself is free; entering individual picking orchards to harvest grapes is charged separately, either by weight or by each orchard's own rules, and prices vary by vendor — confirm with the growers on site.

transportEn.publicTransit: Take transport to Changli County town first, then a local bus or taxi on to Xishanchang village; there's no direct high-speed rail or long-distance bus service.
transportEn.driving: From Qinhuangdao or Beidaihe railway station, drive along the coastal expressway toward Changli, then head northwest about 7 km after reaching the county town; the full trip takes roughly 40-60 minutes.

tipsEn: Peak picking season is August-September, though different grape varieties are ready for picking anywhere from July to November.
Admission to the valley is free, but picking grapes inside the orchards is usually charged by weight — ask about pricing before you start.
Combine it with nearby wineries such as Huaxia Manor and Chateau Kings International Winery for a full wine-country day trip.
Summer and autumn sun in Changli can be strong, so bring sun protection and wear light shoes suited to walking between the fields.
There are many independent growers on site, so it's worth comparing a few before you buy; weekends in peak season can get crowded.

faqEn.q: How much does it cost to enter Grape Valley?
faqEn.a: The scenic area itself is free to enter at any time, but picking grapes inside the orchards is typically charged separately by weight.

faqEn.q: When is the best time to go grape picking?
faqEn.a: The picking season generally runs from July to November, with most varieties at their peak — and the best overall experience — in August and September.

faqEn.q: Are there wineries nearby to visit as well?
faqEn.a: Changli is known as China's wine-producing hometown, and nearby wineries like Huaxia Manor and Chateau Kings International Winery can easily be visited on the same day.

spots.name: 华夏庄园景区
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市昌黎县城北昌抚公路西侧
spots.desc: 华夏庄园隶属中粮集团旗下长城葡萄酒，始建于1988年，位于昌黎县城北昌抚公路西侧，占地约5.6万亩，是国家4A级旅游景区、全国首批工业旅游示范点。庄园东临渤海、背靠碣石山，拥有亚洲第一大地下酒窖，集酿酒葡萄种植、干红酒生产、观光科普、生态园体验于一体，是了解中国干红葡萄酒文化的代表性景区之一。园区内设有国际酿酒葡萄名种示范区和长城葡萄酒学院研究中心，可参观自动化灌装生产线并进行品酒体验，适合葡萄酒爱好者及亲子家庭游览。
highlights: 全自动灌装生产线参观
国际酿酒葡萄名种示范区
长城葡萄酒学院研究中心
spots.bestSeason: 夏秋两季（秋季葡萄采摘季最佳）
spots.suitableFor: 葡萄酒爱好者、家庭游客、文化体验

spots.descEn: Huaxia Manor, part of COFCO's Great Wall Winery brand, was founded in 1988 on a roughly 5.6 million-square-meter estate north of Changli town. As a national 4A scenic area and one of China's first industrial-tourism demonstration sites, it houses Asia's largest underground wine cellar alongside vineyards, an automated bottling line and a wine research institute. Visitors can tour the cellar, see grape cultivation demonstration plots, and join guided tastings, making it a good stop for wine enthusiasts and families interested in China's red-wine heritage.

faq.a: 近期网络信息显示门票在60-80元区间（淡旺季不同），但也有资料显示30元，价格存在差异，建议出发前通过官方或购票平台核实当日价格。
可以，园区提供品酒项目，通常需要单独购买品酒套餐或选择含品酒的联票。
地下酒窖是华夏庄园的招牌项目，号称亚洲第一大地下酒窖，是园区最主要的参观亮点之一。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Summer and autumn, with the fall grape-harvest season being best of all.
spots.suitableForEn: Wine lovers, families, and anyone interested in cultural experiences.
spots.ticketNotesEn: Tickets run roughly ¥60-80 depending on the season, though the site's own historical data lists ¥30 — a discrepancy from more recent figures — so check the official or third-party booking price on the day of your visit. Reports indicate free admission for children under 1.2 m and seniors over 70, and some sources mention a half-price discount for Qinhuangdao residents with local ID (possibly an outdated policy). Prices and discounts change between peak and off-peak seasons, so confirm the current price and whether wine tasting is included via a platform like Ctrip or by phone before buying.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Generally open 08:30-17:30 on regular days and 08:00-18:00 on holidays. Other sources give different seasonal hours: roughly 08:40-16:30 from April 1 to October 15, and roughly 09:10-16:30 from October 16 to January 31 and February 2 to March 31 — check the hours posted on site.

transportEn.publicTransit: No confirmed direct bus service; a taxi from Changli County town or Beidaihe railway station is recommended.
transportEn.driving: About 30 km from Beidaihe — take the Jingshen Expressway, exit at Funing, then follow the Changfu Road for about 20 km.

tipsEn: Reported ticket prices vary online (roughly ¥30-80), so confirm the current price through an official channel or booking platform before you set out.
You can add a wine-tasting package on site to sample several dry red wines.
The autumn grape harvest (September-October) is the best time to visit, and it pairs well with a stop at nearby Grape Valley.
The underground wine cellar is noticeably cool, so bring a light jacket.
As a designated industrial tourism site, the grounds are fairly large — budget at least 2-3 hours for a visit.

faqEn.q: How much are tickets to Huaxia Manor?
faqEn.a: Recent reports put ticket prices at roughly ¥60-80 depending on the season, though some sources list ¥30 — figures vary, so confirm the current price through an official channel or booking platform before you go.

faqEn.q: Can you do wine tasting there?
faqEn.a: Yes. The estate offers wine tasting, usually as a separately purchased package or bundled with a combo ticket.

faqEn.q: Is the underground wine cellar worth seeing?
faqEn.a: Yes — it's Huaxia Manor's signature feature, billed as the largest underground wine cellar in Asia, and one of the main highlights of a visit.

spots.name: 老君顶景区
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市海港区石门寨镇房庄村
spots.desc: 老君顶景区位于秦皇岛市海港区石门寨镇房庄村，主峰海拔493.7米，是石门诸山之冠，北、东、南三面陡峭崇山环绕，向南朝渤海开口，融合道教文化、地质文化与河流文化，是秦皇岛知名的避暑与户外目的地。景区标志性项目是夏季漂流：包括总长约2.5公里的高空环山漂流和全程约3.5公里的龙须河河谷漂流，惊险刺激又能消暑降温；冬季则化身冰雪嘉年华，提供滑雪、滑冰、冰壶等项目，一年四季均有可玩内容，是家庭亲子和年轻游客的热门选择。
highlights: 龙须河河谷漂流(约3.5公里)
spots.bestSeason: 夏季（漂流避暑）、冬季（冰雪嘉年华）
spots.suitableFor: 家庭亲子、年轻人、户外运动爱好者

spots.descEn: Laojunding Scenic Area sits in Shimenzhai Township, Haigang District, Qinhuangdao, its main peak rising 493.7 meters and ringed by steep hills on three sides, opening south toward the Bohai Sea. Blending Taoist heritage with the local geology and river landscape, it is best known for summer whitewater and canyon rafting routes of roughly 2.5 km and 3.5 km, and for a winter ice-and-snow carnival with skiing, skating and curling. It draws families, young travelers and outdoor enthusiasts across both seasons.

faq.a: 登山本身不设门票，主要消费是漂流项目，高山漂流约90元、河谷漂流约130元，第三方平台常有更低的促销票。
可在秦皇岛海阳路汽车站乘坐820路公交直达景区，上午7:20-9:00发车，下午14:20-16:00返程，班次较少建议提前规划。

faq.q: 冬天去老君顶能玩什么？
faq.a: 冬季景区会举办冰雪嘉年华，提供滑雪、滑冰、冰壶等项目，与夏季漂流形成鲜明对比。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Summer for rafting and cooling off, winter for the ice and snow carnival.
spots.suitableForEn: Families, young travelers, and outdoor sports enthusiasts.
spots.ticketNotesEn: There's no admission fee just for hiking the mountain; rafting and similar activities are ticketed separately — roughly ¥90 for the alpine rafting course and ¥130 for the valley rafting course, with lower group-buy starting prices on third-party platforms. Tickets are sold by category (rafting, sightseeing, snow-park, etc.); platforms like Qunar have shown canyon-rafting promo tickets from ¥9.9 and alpine-rafting deals from ¥80, with actual prices fluctuating by season and platform promotions — check the official channel or a booking platform for the current price before buying.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Open 08:00-17:00; seasonal activities like rafting follow the scenic area's current-season announcements, and the winter snow programs typically run from December through February.

transportEn.publicTransit: Bus route 820 from the Haiyang Road bus station in Qinhuangdao goes directly to the scenic area, running roughly 7:20-9:00 AM outbound and 2:20-4:00 PM for the return trip.
transportEn.driving: About 30-40 km from downtown Qinhuangdao, along winding mountain roads to Fangzhuang village in Shimenzhai township; the drive takes roughly 1 hour.

tipsEn: Rafting is the main draw — if visiting in summer, bring a change of clothes and a waterproof bag for electronics.
Bus route 820 runs infrequently, so a private car or chartered ride offers more flexibility.
The winter ice and snow carnival includes skiing, skating, and curling, which are charged separately and may require booking equipment in advance.
Prices vary significantly between ticket types (alpine rafting, valley rafting, sightseeing, season pass), so compare prices on a booking platform before you go.
Summer weekends and the peak holiday season can get crowded — consider visiting on off-peak days or booking ahead.

faqEn.q: How much does it cost to visit Laojunding?
faqEn.a: There's no charge just for hiking the mountain. The main expense is the rafting activities — about ¥90 for alpine rafting and ¥130 for valley rafting — with lower promotional prices often available on third-party platforms.

faqEn.q: How do I get there by bus?
faqEn.a: Take bus route 820 from the Haiyang Road bus station in Qinhuangdao directly to the scenic area. It departs roughly 7:20-9:00 AM and returns 2:20-4:00 PM; since service is infrequent, plan ahead.

faqEn.q: What can you do at Laojunding in winter?
faqEn.a: The scenic area hosts an ice and snow carnival with skiing, skating, and curling — a sharp contrast to the summer rafting.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市昌黎县碣石酒乡1号
spots.desc: 金士国际葡萄酒庄由天士力控股集团投资建设，占地674亩，坐落在碣石山葡萄酒产区，距黄金海岸约18公里，是国家3A级旅游景区。庄园集精品酿酒葡萄种植、特色葡萄酒酿造、葡萄酒文化展示与旅游观光于一体，园区建有游客中心、天宫葡萄酒文化巨型壁画群（约5800平方米）、360度观景天台、葡萄酒诗词壁刻群、酒吧餐厅及鲜食水果采摘园等设施。招牌产品马瑟兰特色葡萄酒已累计获得152项国际大奖，是当地融合葡萄酒文化与康养理念的代表性酒庄之一，已对外开放接待游客参观和品酒。

spots.descEn: Chateau Kings International Winery, developed by the Tasly Group, covers roughly 45 hectares in the Jieshi Mountain wine region about 18 km from Beidaihe's Golden Coast, and holds national 3A scenic-area status. It combines premium grape cultivation, wine production, cultural displays and tourism, featuring a visitor center, a large themed mural complex (~5,800 sqm), a 360-degree viewing deck, poetry-inscribed walls, a bar/restaurant and a fruit-picking orchard. Its signature Marselan wine has won 152 international awards, and the estate is open to the public for tours and tastings.

spots.descEn: Hongxing Industrial Culture Park is built around the production site of Qinhuangdao Hongxing Steel Group in Changli's circular-economy industrial park, covering about 285,000 square meters as a national 3A-rated industrial tourism site. Visitors can observe the steelmaking process up close, tour a museum tracing the company's nearly 20-year history, and see a carbon-neutrality demonstration zone alongside performances of local Changli intangible-heritage arts. Opened around 2022, the park mainly welcomes pre-booked group visits and is popular for study tours and corporate/Party-building activities.

faqEn.q: What's the main thing to see there?
faqEn.a: Highlights include the Hongxing origin exhibition hall, the steel production line, the carbon-neutrality demonstration zone, and local intangible-heritage performances from the Changli area.

spots.desc: 龙云谷景区位于秦皇岛市抚宁区大新寨镇张各庄村，主峰海拔905米，是国家3A级旅游景区，以群峰竞秀、山泉飞瀑的自然峡谷景观为核心特色。景区内建有约3000米木质栈道贯穿峡谷，设有530米高空悬挑玻璃栈道和华北首条约2200米的悬崖漂流项目，龙潭瀑布、天池瀑布沿途可见，夏季峡谷中28种鲜花竞相开放形成花海景观，山间还分布天女木兰等珍稀植物。置身龙潭峡谷可听泉水叮咚、望巨石悬空，是户外探险和避暑纳凉的好去处，冬季则可观赏冰瀑奇观。

spots.descEn: Longyungu Scenic Area sits in Zhanggezhuang Village, Daxinzhai Township, Funing District, its main peak reaching 905 meters. A national 3A attraction, it features a roughly 3,000-meter wooden boardwalk through the canyon, a 530-meter glass skywalk, and North China's first cliff-side rafting course (~2,200 m), alongside waterfalls such as Longtan and Tianchi. In summer the canyon fills with wildflowers from some 28 species, and winter brings striking ice-waterfall scenery, making it a year-round destination for hikers and photographers.

The glass skywalk and cliffside rafting are paid add-ons not included in the standard ticket. With several package options available, compare prices and included activities across platforms before buying.

tipsEn: The glass skywalk and the alpine slide/cliffside rafting are paid add-ons on top of the standard admission ticket.
The canyon stays cool in summer, making it a popular local spot to escape the heat and play in the water.
The wooden "stairway to heaven" section is fairly steep — visitors with limited stamina should pace themselves, and non-slip shoes are recommended.
Fall brings colorful foliage and winter brings frozen waterfalls, so the scenery changes noticeably across seasons.

faqEn.q: How much are tickets to Longyungu?
faqEn.a: Standard admission is ¥50 per person, with combo packages also available at ¥140, ¥240, and ¥120 with different inclusions — check a booking platform for the current pricing.

faqEn.q: Do the glass skywalk and rafting cost extra?

faqEn.q: Is it open year-round?
faqEn.a: Yes, the scenic area is open year-round from 08:00 to 16:30 — summer is good for cooling off in the water, winter for viewing frozen waterfalls, and autumn for fall foliage.

spots.desc: 棋盘山景区位于秦皇岛市卢龙县刘田各庄镇前上庄村，总面积约1.2平方公里。卢龙为古孤竹国都城所在地，相传西周时期孤竹国二公子伯夷、叔齐曾在此隐居守节，为当地增添了深厚的历史文化底蕴。景区因山顶一块形似棋盘的巨石而得名，传说石槽中的棋子可以挪动却无法取出，故称“仙人对弈”，是景区最具辨识度的地质奇观。园区内还建有梯田花海景观和约600亩的鲜果采摘园，抗战时期这里曾是冀东抗日模范根据地，兼具自然景观、历史传说与红色文化多重看点。
highlights: 仙人对弈巨石(棋子可挪不可拿)

spots.descEn: Qipanshan Scenic Area, covering about 1.2 sq km, lies in Qianshangzhuang Village, Liutianzhuang Township, Lulong County — the site of the ancient Guzhu state, where legend says the noble brothers Boyi and Shuqi lived in seclusion. The park takes its name from a large boulder atop the peak resembling a chessboard, with a folk tale claiming its stone "pieces" can be moved but never removed. It also features terraced flower fields and a roughly 600-mu fruit-picking orchard, and served as a model anti-Japanese resistance base during WWII, blending natural scenery, legend and revolutionary history.

faq.q: 棋盘山景区和沈阳的棋盘山是一个地方吗？
faq.a: 不是。本景区位于秦皇岛市卢龙县刘田各庄镇，沈阳棋盘山是辽宁省的另一处同名景区，两者无关联，预订时需注意区分。
指山顶一块形似棋盘的巨石，传说石槽中的棋子只能挪动无法取出，因此得名'仙人对弈'，是景区标志性的地质奇观。
春季适合赏花，秋季是核桃和水果采摘旺季，两季均为推荐游览时间。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Spring for flowers, autumn for the walnut and fruit harvest.
spots.suitableForEn: Families, fruit-picking enthusiasts, and history and culture buffs.
spots.ticketNotesEn: The listed price is ¥135 (this figure comes from existing site data and hasn't been independently reconfirmed — check with an official or third-party platform before buying). Other Lulong-area scenic sites reportedly offer free admission for seniors 70 and older with ID and for visitors with disability certification, but it's unconfirmed whether that policy applies here — check discount details for seniors and children on site or by phone.

transportEn.driving: About 20 km from Lulong County town, driving to Qianshangzhuang village in Liutianggezhuang township.

tipsEn: Public information about this scenic area is limited — call the local tourism authority or check a third-party platform for current ticket prices and hours before visiting.
The autumn walnut and fruit harvest is a highlight, so plan an autumn visit if picking interests you.
The legendary boulder formation at the summit is the top attraction — check the trail difficulty and weather conditions before climbing.

There are similarly or identically named scenic areas elsewhere (such as Qipanshan in Shenyang, or the "Zuoyou Valley" in Lulong) — double-check the full name and address when booking to avoid confusion.
The ¥135 ticket price is relatively high, so look for online discounts and book ahead if available.

faqEn.q: Is this Qipanshan the same as the one in Shenyang?
faqEn.a: No. This scenic area is in Liutianggezhuang township, Lulong County, Qinhuangdao, while Shenyang's Qipanshan is a separate, unrelated site in Liaoning province with the same name — check carefully when booking.

faqEn.q: What does "Immortals at Chess" (xianren duiyi) refer to?
faqEn.a: It refers to a summit boulder shaped like a chessboard; legend holds that the chess pieces carved into its grooves can be moved but never removed — hence the name, and it's the scenic area's signature geological curiosity.

faqEn.q: What's the best season to visit?
faqEn.a: Spring is good for flowers, and autumn is peak season for walnut and fruit picking — both are recommended times to visit.

spots.name: 五峰山景区
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市昌黎县两山乡五峰山村
spots.desc: 五峰山位于昌黎县城北两山乡五峰山村，距碣石山风景区约10公里，为古碣石十景之一"五峰屏开"。景区由挂月峰、飞来峰、平斗峰、锦绣峰、望海峰五座山峰组成，峰峰异状，环列如屏，其中飞来峰最高，海拔约507米。这里也是中国马克思主义早期传播的重要策源地，革命先驱李大钊曾八上五峰山，在明代建筑韩文公祠一带避险读书，写下《我的马克思主义观》《再论问题与主义》等文章，山中留有李大钊塑像和多处名人石刻。景区兼具自然山景与红色历史，适合登山爱好者和红色教育、历史文化爱好者前往。
spots.bestSeason: 春季（4-5月）和秋季（9-10月），气候凉爽、植被状态好
spots.suitableFor: 红色旅游、历史文化爱好者、登山健身者
spots.tips: 门票价格较低，性价比高，适合安排半天行程 山路以登山步道为主，建议穿防滑运动鞋 可与碣石山、昌黎黄金海岸等景区串联游览 红色教育元素较多，适合带孩子做历史研学 山中林木茂密，夏季注意防蚊虫

spots.descEn: Wufeng (Five Peaks) Mountain lies north of Changli County, about 10 km from Jieshi Mountain. Its five distinctively shaped peaks, the highest around 507 m, form a screen-like ridge long listed among the "Ten Scenes of Ancient Jieshi." It is also historically significant as a site where the early Chinese Marxist Li Dazhao took refuge and wrote key essays. A statue of Li Dazhao, inscribed rocks, and the Ming-dynasty Hanwengong Shrine remain on the mountain, making it a mix of hiking and revolutionary-history tourism.
highlightsEn: Li Dazhao statue and rock inscriptions

faq.q: 五峰山适合带老人小孩去吗？
faq.a: 山不算太高但以山路步行为主，体力一般的老人小孩建议量力而行，选择较缓的路段。

faq.q: 山上有李大钊相关的哪些遗迹？
faq.a: 有李大钊塑像、多处名人石刻以及他曾避险读书写作的明代韩文公祠一带旧址。
网络资料显示票价在10-13元左右，具体以景区现场公示为准。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Spring (April-May) and autumn (September-October), when the weather is cool and the vegetation is at its best.
spots.suitableForEn: Red tourism, history and culture enthusiasts, hikers
spots.ticketNotesEn: Around ¥13 (some online sources list ¥10 instead, so figures are inconsistent across platforms). No information was found on combo tickets or online booking requirements; check the current price posted at the site or on a booking platform before you go.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Open all day, with no published difference between peak and off-peak hours. It's best to visit during daylight and head back down before sunset.

transportEn.publicTransit: From Changli Railway Station, minivans run directly to the scenic area.
transportEn.driving: From downtown Qinhuangdao, take the Jing-Ha Expressway to the coastal expressway, exit at Changli/Golden Coast, then follow the Changli-Huanghai connector road onto Wufengshan Road. The drive takes about 1 hour from the city center.

tipsEn: Ticket prices are low, making this a good value half-day trip.
The trails are mostly hiking paths, so wear non-slip athletic shoes.
Combine it with nearby Jieshi Mountain or Changli Golden Coast for a fuller itinerary.
The site has strong revolutionary-history content, making it a good history lesson for kids.
The forest cover is dense, so watch for mosquitoes in summer.

faqEn.q: Is Wufeng Mountain suitable for elderly visitors or children?
faqEn.a: The mountain isn't very high, but the route is mostly on foot, so elderly visitors and children with limited stamina should pace themselves and stick to the gentler sections.

faqEn.q: What Li Dazhao-related sites are on the mountain?
faqEn.a: There is a statue of Li Dazhao, several inscribed rock carvings by notable figures, and the site near the Ming-dynasty Han Wengong Temple where he once took refuge to read and write.

faqEn.q: How much is admission?
faqEn.a: Online sources put the price at around ¥10-13; check the price posted on site for the exact figure.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市抚宁区城北约10公里，102国道附近
spots.desc: 天马山位于秦皇岛市抚宁区城北约10公里处，属燕山余脉，海拔约300米，因顶峰巨石远望似云中奔马而得名，原名"马头崖"，被称为抚宁第一名胜。明代蓟镇总兵戚继光巡边至此，留下"天马山""山河一览""天马行空""海天在目"等多处摩崖石刻，1982年被列为河北省级重点文物保护单位。山中巨石叠砌、洞穴众多，并有"猴儿望海"等造型奇特的自然景观。山体不高，往返步行约4公里，适合作为半日休闲登山、了解明代边关历史的目的地。

spots.descEn: Tianma ("Heavenly Horse") Mountain sits about 10 km north of Funing District, Qinhuangdao, rising to roughly 300 m. It is named for a summit boulder resembling a galloping horse. Ming-dynasty general Qi Jiguang, who defended this stretch of the Great Wall, left several rock inscriptions here, now a provincial cultural relic. The mountain features stacked boulders, caves, and whimsically shaped rocks such as "Monkey Watching the Sea." It's an easy half-day hike combining natural scenery with Ming border-defense history.
highlightsEn: Summit views over the Yanshan range and Bohai Sea

faq.a: 网络信息不一致，出行前建议致电景区或在购票平台查询当天实时价格。

海拔约300米，往返约4公里，路况以石阶和碎石为主，普通游客均可完成。

transportEn.driving: Follow National Highway 102 to a point about 9-10 km north of Funing District's urban area. It's about 45 km from downtown Qinhuangdao, roughly a 1-hour drive.

faqEn.q: How much does admission to Tianma Mountain cost?
faqEn.a: Online information is inconsistent, so it's best to call the site or check a booking platform for the day's actual price before you go.

faqEn.q: What's the top attraction at Tianma Mountain?
faqEn.a: The Qi Jiguang cliff carvings near and along the way to the summit, a provincial-level protected cultural relic.

faqEn.q: Is the hike difficult?
faqEn.a: The peak is about 300 m in elevation with a roughly 4 km round trip, mostly on stone steps and loose gravel — manageable for ordinary visitors.

spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市卢龙县蛤泊镇鲍子沟村
spots.desc: 鲍子沟景区位于秦皇岛市卢龙县蛤泊镇鲍子沟村，三面环山，地处北纬40度附近的优良葡萄产地，被誉为"渤海之滨吐鲁番"。当地种植葡萄已有300多年历史，全村耕地及可开发荒山基本都种上了以玫瑰香为主的食用葡萄，面积约1500亩，另有美人指、阳光玫瑰、红提、巨峰等十余个品种，年产量约400万-500万斤。自2002年起，鲍子沟村探索葡萄产业与乡村旅游结合的发展路径，景区总面积约30平方公里，集葡萄采摘、奇石观赏、登高望远、湖畔垂钓于一体，已入选全国农业旅游示范点，是家庭亲子采摘和乡村生态游的热门去处。

spots.descEn: Baozigou is a grape-growing village and scenic area in Hebo Town, Lulong County, surrounded by hills near the 40th parallel — good grape-growing latitude that has earned it the nickname "Turpan by the Bohai Sea." Grapes have been cultivated here for over 300 years, and roughly 1,500 mu of farmland now grow Rose Honey and other varieties such as Sunshine Rose and Kyoho. Since 2002 the village has combined grape farming with rural tourism, offering fruit picking, rock formations, hilltop views, and lakeside fishing. It is a recognized national agri-tourism demonstration site, popular for family fruit-picking trips.
highlightsEn: Rose Honey, Sunshine Rose and other varieties

faq.a: 景区本身免费开放，采摘葡萄按现场重量另行付费。
8-10月葡萄成熟期最佳，可现场采摘多个品种。

faq.q: 附近还有什么可以一起玩？
faq.a: 与昌黎葡萄沟相邻，可安排在同一天的行程中。

spots.bestSeasonEn: August to October, during the grape harvest and picking season.
spots.suitableForEn: Families with children, fruit-picking visitors, rural eco-tourism fans
spots.ticketNotesEn: Free to enter; grape picking is charged by weight on site, with the exact rate varying by variety and year. No standard published price was found.

transportEn.driving: Take the Jing-Ha Expressway to the Changlu Road, then head east on Changlu Road for about 1 km. It can be combined with a visit to nearby Changli Grape Valley.

tipsEn: Grapes ripen progressively from August to October, making this the best window for picking.
Entry to the village is free; picking is charged by weight, so bring a shopping bag or cash.
It's close to Changli Grape Valley, so the two can be visited on the same day.
The village roads are narrow, so drivers should aim to visit at off-peak times.
The terrain is hilly, so keep an eye on uneven ground when bringing children or elderly visitors.

faqEn.q: Is there an admission fee for Baozigou?
faqEn.a: The scenic area itself is free to enter; grape picking is charged separately by weight on site.

faqEn.q: When is the best time to visit?
faqEn.a: August to October, during peak grape season, when several varieties are available for picking.

faqEn.q: What else is nearby?
faqEn.a: It's adjacent to Changli Grape Valley, so the two can be combined into a single day's itinerary.

spots.name: 柳河溪谷
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市卢龙县刘田各庄镇柳河北山村
spots.desc: 柳河溪谷位于秦皇岛市卢龙县刘田各庄镇柳河北山村北，毗邻冀东抗战纪念馆，当地素有"长寿北山、红色北山、绿色北山"之称。1943-1945年间，冀东十二地委和专署机关曾在此办公，是冀东抗日根据地的堡垒村庄之一。景区依山傍水、群山环抱，建有林中木屋和别墅，集绿色种植、果品采摘、休闲垂钓和红色教育于一体，是卢龙县夏季休闲乡村游线路的代表景点之一，常与碧霞山庄、棋盘山绿色庄园、左右山谷等景区串联游览。
highlights: 冀东抗日根据地堡垒村旧址
林中木屋与别墅度假区
spots.suitableFor: 红色旅游、亲子家庭、乡村生态游爱好者
spots.tips: 可与紧邻的冀东抗战纪念馆一并参观，加深红色历史了解 夏秋季节适合采摘和避暑纳凉 免费开放，适合家庭自驾一日游 山区道路较窄，建议白天出行 与柳河山庄、左右山谷等景区距离较近，可规划环线游览
spots.transport: 自驾:从卢龙县城驱车前往刘田各庄镇，沿路可导航"柳河溪谷"或"冀东抗战纪念馆"，位于镇区东北方向约10公里。
spots.ticketNotes: 景区本身免费开放，园内果品采摘、垂钓等项目可能单独收费，未查到具体价目。

transportDetail.driving: 从卢龙县城驱车前往刘田各庄镇，沿路可导航"柳河溪谷"或"冀东抗战纪念馆"，位于镇区东北方向约10公里。

tipsList: 可与紧邻的冀东抗战纪念馆一并参观，加深红色历史了解
夏秋季节适合采摘和避暑纳凉
免费开放，适合家庭自驾一日游
山区道路较窄，建议白天出行
与柳河山庄、左右山谷等景区距离较近，可规划环线游览
spots.descEn: Liuhe Valley lies north of Liuhe Beishan Village in Liutianjiazhuang Town, Lulong County, next to the Jidong Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall. From 1943-1945 it served as the office of the Jidong 12th District Committee, making it a stronghold village of the Jidong anti-Japanese base area — hence its local reputation for "longevity, revolutionary history, and greenery." Surrounded by hills and water, the site has forest cabins and villas, and combines organic farming, fruit picking, fishing, and patriotic-education tourism. It is often visited together with nearby Biixia Manor and other Lulong countryside scenic spots.
highlightsEn: Adjacent to Jidong War Memorial Hall

faq.q: 柳河溪谷和冀东抗战纪念馆是一个地方吗？
faq.a: 两者相邻但并非同一场所，柳河溪谷是依托柳河北山村自然风光和红色历史打造的乡村旅游区，紧邻冀东抗战纪念馆。
景区本身免费开放，部分采摘、垂钓等体验项目可能单独收费。
夏秋两季气候宜人，果品也在此时成熟，是最佳游览期。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Summer (June-August) and autumn (September-October).
spots.suitableForEn: Red tourism, family outings, rural eco-tourism fans
spots.ticketNotesEn: The scenic area itself is free to enter. Fruit picking, fishing, and similar activities inside may be charged separately, but no specific pricing was found.

transportEn.driving: From Lulong County, drive toward Liutianjiazhuang Town; you can navigate to "Liuhe Valley" (Liuhe Xigu) or the "Jidong Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall," located about 10 km northeast of the town center.

tipsEn: Combine it with the adjacent Jidong Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall for a deeper look at the area's revolutionary history.
Summer and autumn are ideal for fruit picking and escaping the heat.
Admission is free, making it a good family day-trip destination by car.
Mountain roads here are narrow, so it's best to travel during daylight.
It's close to Liuhe Manor and Zuoyou Valley, so a loop route combining several sites is possible.

faqEn.q: Are Liuhe Valley and the Jidong Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall the same place?
faqEn.a: They are adjacent but not the same site. Liuhe Valley is a rural tourism area built around the natural scenery and revolutionary history of Liuhebeishan Village, located right next to the memorial hall.

faqEn.q: Is there an admission fee?
faqEn.a: The scenic area itself is free; some picking and fishing experiences inside may be charged separately.

faqEn.q: What season is best to visit?
faqEn.a: Summer and autumn, when the weather is pleasant and the fruit is in season, are the best times to visit.

spots.name: 柳河山庄
spots.openTime: 全天开放（具体参观/品酒项目时段建议提前咨询）
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市卢龙县刘田各庄镇冯家山村
spots.desc: 柳河山庄位于秦皇岛市卢龙县刘田各庄镇冯家山村，由秦皇岛柳河山庄葡萄酒业有限公司投资兴建，拥有一定规模的酿酒葡萄种植基地和葡萄酒加工厂，是集葡萄种植、葡萄酒酿造、庄园观光和休闲度假于一体的乡村旅游综合体。庄园以红酒文化体验为核心，将葡萄园、庄园景观与葡萄酒文化结合，配套木屋度假区，是秦皇岛"葡萄酒+旅游"模式的代表之一，也是卢龙县庄园乡村休闲游线路上的重要节点，曾被评为农业旅游示范点。适合对葡萄酒文化感兴趣的游客、商务团队和情侣休闲出游。
highlights: 酿酒葡萄种植基地观光
spots.bestSeason: 秋季（9-10月）葡萄成熟酿酒季
spots.suitableFor: 葡萄酒爱好者、商务团队、情侣休闲
spots.tips: 适合安排在葡萄成熟的秋季（9-10月）前往，体验采摘与品酒 园区体验项目（品酒、住宿等）建议提前电话或线上确认 可与相邻的柳河溪谷、左右山谷等景区组合成一日游线路 商务团建、情侣出游可考虑入住园内木屋 山区自驾建议提前规划路线，部分路段导航信号较弱
spots.transport: 自驾:秦皇岛市区驾车经碧霞山庄、木井镇方向前往柳河山庄，路程约1-1.5小时（具体以实时导航为准）。
spots.ticketNotes: 庄园本身免费开放，品酒、住宿、采摘等体验项目通常单独收费，具体价目网络未查到统一公示，建议提前联系确认。此前网络资料中提及的"9D乐园"未能通过本次检索独立核实，请谨慎采信。

transportDetail.driving: 秦皇岛市区驾车经碧霞山庄、木井镇方向前往柳河山庄，路程约1-1.5小时（具体以实时导航为准）。

tipsList: 适合安排在葡萄成熟的秋季（9-10月）前往，体验采摘与品酒

可与相邻的柳河溪谷、左右山谷等景区组合成一日游线路
商务团建、情侣出游可考虑入住园内木屋
山区自驾建议提前规划路线，部分路段导航信号较弱
spots.descEn: Liuhe Manor is a winery-resort in Fengjiashan Village, Liutianjiazhuang Town, Lulong County, built by a local wine company. It combines wine-grape vineyards, a winemaking facility, and manor-style grounds with leisure lodging in wooden cabins, making it a representative "wine plus tourism" destination near Qinhuangdao. Visitors can tour the vineyards and winery, learn about the winemaking process, and relax on the grounds. It suits wine enthusiasts, business groups, and couples looking for a quiet countryside getaway.

faq.a: 园区参观免费，品酒、住宿等增值体验项目通常另行收费。

faq.q: 可以现场品酒或购买葡萄酒吗？
faq.a: 作为葡萄酒生产企业配套的庄园，通常提供品酒和购酒服务，具体以现场安排为准，建议提前咨询。
秋季葡萄成熟、酿酒季氛围最浓，是最佳游览时间。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Autumn (September-October), during the grape harvest and winemaking season.
spots.suitableForEn: Wine enthusiasts, corporate groups, couples
spots.ticketNotesEn: The manor itself is free to enter; wine tasting, lodging, and picking experiences are usually charged separately, with no standard published pricing found online — it's best to contact the manor in advance to confirm. A "9D amusement park" mentioned in some online sources could not be independently verified in this research, so treat that claim with caution.

transportEn.driving: From downtown Qinhuangdao, drive via Bixia Manor and Mujing Town toward Liuhe Manor; the trip takes about 1-1.5 hours (check real-time navigation for the current route).

tipsEn: Autumn (September-October), during grape harvest, is the best time to visit for picking and tasting.
Call ahead or check online to confirm on-site experiences like tastings and lodging.
It can be combined with the nearby Liuhe Valley and Zuoyou Valley for a one-day route.
Corporate groups and couples may want to consider staying in the manor's log cabins.
Plan your driving route in advance, as GPS signal can be weak in parts of this mountainous area.

faqEn.q: Is there an admission fee for Liuhe Manor?
faqEn.a: Touring the grounds is free; add-on experiences like wine tasting and lodging are usually charged separately.

faqEn.q: Can you taste or buy wine on site?
faqEn.a: As a winery-affiliated estate, it typically offers tasting and wine sales, though this depends on what's available on the day — it's best to inquire in advance.

faqEn.q: When is the best time to go?
faqEn.a: Autumn, during the grape harvest and winemaking season, offers the best atmosphere.

spots.name: 山海关古城民俗博物馆（王家大院）
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市山海关区古城东三条29号
spots.desc: 王家大院又称山海关古城民俗博物馆，坐落于"天下第一关"城楼西侧，被称为"万里长城第一家"，始建于明末清初，鼎盛于清晚期。院落为典型明清四合庭院式建筑群，占地十余亩，建筑面积2000多平方米，由三个套院、18个展厅组成。宅院原主人王三佛是山西盐商，因家业兴旺被称为"山海关南半城"。如今大院辟为民俗博物馆，通过实景陈设和展品展示明清时期山海关古城居民的生活场景与民俗文化，是了解晋商文化和山海关古城历史的重要窗口，适合历史文化爱好者、古建筑研究者及亲子研学。
highlights: 山海关古城民俗生活复原场景
spots.bestSeason: 全年皆宜（室内参观为主），春秋季节古城整体游览体验更好
spots.suitableFor: 历史文化爱好者、古建筑研究者、亲子研学
spots.tips: 与天下第一关城楼相邻，建议安排在同一行程中一并游览 出行前建议在携程等平台核实当日票价，网络记载有30元和50元两种说法 馆内为室内展陈，四季均可参观，雨雪天气也不受影响 适合结合古城其他历史街区做半天到一天的深度游 想了解晋商文化和山海关古城民俗的游客不要错过
spots.transport: 公共交通:山海关火车站出站后步行至天下第一关景区，王家大院位于城楼西侧，步行即可到达。 自驾:自秦皇岛市区沿秦皇西大街/庆首道方向经G228或市区道路前往山海关古城，车程约30-40分钟；自北戴河站方向约30分钟车程。
spots.ticketNotes: 30元（网络另有50元说法，来源不一致）；不同平台票价记载不一致（30元与50元均有出现），与天下第一关景区相邻，是否有联票需现场或购票平台核实，建议出行前通过携程等平台确认当日实时价格。

transportDetail.driving: 自秦皇岛市区沿秦皇西大街/庆首道方向经G228或市区道路前往山海关古城，车程约30-40分钟；自北戴河站方向约30分钟车程。

spots.descEn: Wang Family Courtyard, also known as the Shanhaiguan Folk Museum, sits just west of the First Pass Under Heaven watchtower and is billed as the "first house along the Great Wall." Built in the late Ming to early Qing period, it is a classic Ming-Qing courtyard complex of three linked courtyards and 18 exhibition halls on about 2,000+ sq m of floor space. It was originally the home of Wang Sanfo, a wealthy Shanxi salt merchant. Today it houses folk-life exhibits recreating Qing-era domestic scenes, offering visitors a window into Shanhaiguan's old-city history and Shanxi merchant culture.
highlightsEn: Former residence of merchant Wang Sanfo

faq.q: 王家大院和天下第一关是一个门票吗？
faq.a: 两者是相邻但各自独立的景点，是否有联票建议在购票平台或现场售票处确认。
明清四合院建筑本身、18个展厅内的民俗生活场景，以及晋商王三佛家族的历史陈列。
网络资料显示在30-50元之间，不同来源不一致，建议出行前用购票平台核实实时价格。

spots.bestSeasonEn: Suitable year-round since it's mostly an indoor visit, though spring and autumn make for a better overall experience of the old town.
spots.suitableForEn: History and culture enthusiasts, researchers of traditional architecture, family educational trips
spots.ticketNotesEn: Around ¥30 (some online sources list ¥50 instead, so figures are inconsistent across platforms). It's next to the First Pass Under Heaven scenic area, so whether a combo ticket is available should be confirmed on site or through a booking platform; check a site like Ctrip for the day's real-time price before you go.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Roughly 8:00 AM-5:00 PM, with possible seasonal adjustments between peak (May-December) and off-peak hours; one online source cites posted hours of 8:00 AM-5:00 PM from May 4 through December 31.

transportEn.publicTransit: From Shanhaiguan Railway Station, walk to the First Pass Under Heaven scenic area. Wang Family Courtyard is just west of the gate tower and reachable on foot.
transportEn.driving: From downtown Qinhuangdao, head toward Shanhaiguan Old Town via Qinhuang West Street/Qingshou Road or G228; the drive takes about 30-40 minutes. From Beidaihe Railway Station it's about 30 minutes.

tipsEn: It's right next to the First Pass Under Heaven gate tower, so plan to visit both on the same trip.
Check the day's ticket price on a platform like Ctrip before you go — online sources list both ¥30 and ¥50.
The exhibits are entirely indoors, so it's a good option in any season, including rain or snow.
It pairs well with other historic streets in the old town for a half-day to full-day visit.
Don't miss it if you're interested in Shanxi merchant culture and Shanhaiguan folk traditions.

faqEn.q: Does one ticket cover both Wang Family Courtyard and the First Pass Under Heaven?
faqEn.a: They are adjacent but independent attractions; check with the ticketing platform or the on-site box office to see if a combo ticket is available.

faqEn.q: What's worth seeing at Wang Family Courtyard?
faqEn.a: The Ming- and Qing-dynasty courtyard architecture itself, folk-life scenes displayed across 18 exhibition halls, and a historical exhibit on the Shanxi merchant Wang Sanfo's family.

faqEn.q: How much is admission?
faqEn.a: Online sources put it between ¥30 and ¥50, with figures inconsistent across sources — check a booking platform for the current price before you go.

spots.name: 渔田·七里海度假区
spots.address: 河北省秦皇岛市北戴河新区七里海片区侯里村与大韩庄村之间
spots.desc: 渔田·七里海度假区位于秦皇岛市北戴河新区七里海片区（侯里村与大韩庄村之间），是2025年新评的4A级景区，占地约8000亩，水域面积约5000亩，总投资规模较大。景区集大型实景演艺、渔文化体验、亲子动物互动（长颈鹿、水豚、小矮马等）、休闲体验式街区、特色主题民宿于一体，白天以动物互动和戏水项目为主，夜间有由专业团队打造的水上灯光大秀，是目前秦皇岛热度较高的亲子度假目的地之一。景区每年仅在4月底至10月初运营，营业时间较长，适合安排半天到一天，尤其推荐晚间留下观看夜场演艺。
highlights: 长颈鹿、水豚等动物互动
spots.bestSeason: 5-10月夏季运营期，尤以夜场演艺氛围最佳
spots.suitableFor: 亲子家庭、情侣、年轻人、度假休闲人群

spots.descEn: Yutian Qilihai Resort sits in the Qilihai area of Beidaihe New District, between Houli and Dahanzhuang villages. Newly rated as a 4A attraction in 2025, it covers about 8,000 mu (roughly 530 hectares) with 5,000 mu of water area. The resort combines large-scale live shows, fishing-culture exhibits, close-up animal encounters (giraffes, capybaras, miniature horses), themed shopping streets, and boutique lodging. Daytime visits focus on animal interaction and water play, while evenings feature a large light-and-water show. It operates seasonally from late April to early October and is best enjoyed as a full-day-into-evening visit.

faq.q: 渔田七里海度假区全年开放吗？
faq.a: 不是，属季节性运营景区，通常每年4月底至10月初开放，冬季不营业。
成人票109元起，学生/老人90元起，儿童79元起，具体以购票平台当日价格为准，节庆活动期间价格可能上浮。

faq.q: 白天和夜场哪个更值得看？
faq.a: 白天适合亲子戏水和动物互动，夜场的灯光水秀是景区最大亮点，建议尽量留到晚上。

spots.bestSeasonEn: The summer operating season, May to October, is best experienced for its evening show atmosphere.
spots.suitableForEn: Families, couples, young visitors, resort/leisure travelers
spots.ticketNotesEn: Adult tickets start at ¥109 (day and night sessions combined; check the booking platform for the exact price on your travel date). Pricing is tiered: adults from ¥109, students/seniors from ¥90, children over 1.2 m from ¥79, with free admission for children under 1.2 m and qualifying seniors. Prices may rise during special events (an International Fireworks Festival ticket was seen priced at ¥238), so confirm the current price through official channels or Ctrip/Meituan before you go. Package deals combining admission with lodging are usually better value than buying tickets separately.
spots.openTimeNotesEn: Seasonal operation, roughly April 30 to October 7 each year, daily from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM (last entry and ticket sales at 9:30 PM).

transportEn.publicTransit: Take the high-speed rail to Beidaihe Station, then a taxi for about 40 minutes. Alternatively, take bus route 808 to the "Dahanzhuang" stop and walk about 10 minutes.
transportEn.driving: From Beijing, take the Jing-Ha Expressway, about a 3.5-hour drive; from Tianjin, about 3 hours. You can navigate directly to "Yutian Qilihai Resort."
transportEn.parking: The resort has a free parking lot (check current on-site signage for details).

tipsEn: Enter in the afternoon for the water attractions and animal encounters, then stay for the evening show.
The night show is the highlight of the resort — it's worth staying until around 9:00 PM to see it.
Weekends in peak season get crowded, so book tickets online 1-2 days ahead, or book a lodging package for VIP access.
The resort is large (about 8,000 mu, roughly 530 hectares), so expect a lot of walking and wear comfortable shoes.
Weekday visits are noticeably less crowded and offer a better experience.

faqEn.q: Is Yutian Qilihai Resort open all year?
faqEn.a: No, it operates seasonally, typically from late April to early October, and is closed in winter.

faqEn.q: How much does admission cost?
faqEn.a: Adult tickets start at ¥109, students/seniors from ¥90, and children from ¥79; check the booking platform for the current price, as it may rise during festivals and special events.

faqEn.q: Which is better, the daytime or the night show?
faqEn.a: Daytime is great for water play and animal encounters with kids, but the night show's light and water display is the resort's biggest draw — try to stay until evening.
